jobs.description: **System Support Engineer (m/f/d)** **\- Medical/Biosafety/ System Support / GMP / IT troubleshooting / English**For our customer a big pharmaceutical company in Rotkreuz we are looking for a highly qualified System Support Engineer (m/f/d) (EW) \- RZ.**Background:** As a healthcare pioneer and the industry's global leader in in\-vitro diagnostics, the Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what's possible.  Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalization and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness.  The RDS R\&D organization operates globally, with international teams across various sites and countries, and is structured into four networks and four chapter areas. We are currently seeking a passionate and proactive individual to fill the role of System Support Engineer within the RnD Service chapter, located in Rotkreuz (CH).As a System Support Engineer, you will be a key technical expert within a cross\-functional environment, responsible for supporting Roche Diagnostic Systems throughout their entire lifecycle, from development to post\-launch.**The Perfect Candidate:**The Candidate possesses a recognized vocational qualification (such as an EFZ in Mechatronics, Electronics, or Precision/Automotive Mechanics) or a tertiary degree in an engineering discipline. They offer one to three years of verified hands\-on experience, demonstrating a strong aptitude for practical problem\-solving within demanding technical service or maintenance environments.  The position requires solid analytical acumen, with particular emphasis on systematic root\-cause analysis and structured troubleshooting across interconnected hardware, software, and IT configurations. Furthermore, the candidate demonstrates the autonomy and technical diligence necessary to independently commission, maintain, and service advanced diagnostic instrumentation. This profile is completed by professional working proficiency in both English and German, ensuring effective collaboration within cross\-functional R\&D engineering teams.**Tasks \& Responsibilities:*** Serve as a technical expert and primary point of contact for internal customers regarding all service aspects* Install Roche Diagnostics systems (hardware and software) across all development phases\-including early prototypes\-as well as according to installation manuals in the Roche Diagnostics Knowledge (RDK) database* Perform system qualifications (IQ/OQ), execute preventive maintenance, and conduct autonomous troubleshooting and repair of hardware and software issues* Manage the deployment and servicing of various systems and their specific configurations* Ensure comprehensive documentation in accordance with established quality standards* Provide technical support for global development trials**Must Haves:*** HF or university degree in an engineering or life sciences discipline ( , Medical Devices, Electronics/Automation, Mechatronics) or completed technical vocational training with relevant practical experience* Initial experience in, or clear willingness to work in, a highly regulated industry and in laboratories with biosafety levels S1 and S2* First hands\-on experience in a technical or mechanical occupation* Customer\- and service\-oriented team player with strong communication and collaboration skills, featuring an autonomous and proactive work style* Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is essential; German is a plus.**Nice to Have:*** Basic knowledge of network administration and IT troubleshooting* Prior experience servicing diagnostic instruments or involvement in equipment management* Practical experience resolving technical issues across interdisciplinary setups (hardware, software, and laboratory workflows)* Previous experience working in a GMP or ISO\-regulated environment**Reference No : 925359SDA**  **Role: System Support Engineer (m/f/d)**  **Industry: Pharma**  **Workplace: Rotkreuz**  **Pensum: 100%**  **Start:**  **Duration: 12\+\+ months**  **Deadline :**If you are **interested** in this position, please send us your complete dossier. jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Lawyer - Partner level 10 years experience --- Lawyer \\- Partner level 10 years experience =========================================== \*\*Introduction\*\* Logan \\\& Partners Law is a boutique law firm providing legal services to businesses and entrepreneurs in Switzerland, the UK and the EU. As a boutique international law firm, we require a highly autonomous and commercially minded lawyer who can combine sophisticated legal expertise with business development, client relationship management and the ability to manage complex international projects from inception to completion. This includes the ability to provide commercially pragmatic advice that reflects the client's business model, available resources, growth objectives and risk appetite. The candidate must be comfortable working across a broad range of legal and commercial matters, engaging directly with stakeholders at all levels, and taking responsibility for both the delivery of legal services and the development of the firm's business. Additionally the candidate must have experience of working with growing technology companies and providing legal services to senior management in such companies, directly to the CEO, CFO, Chief Revenue Officer, COO, Chief Marketing Officer and/or the General Counsel. Experience of working with technology start\\-ups in Switzerland is also important. The candidate must have extensive international legal experience. This includes strong transactional experience in cross\\-border transactions with large corporates and technology businesses in Europe (Switzerland, United Kingdom, Spain and Russia), and Asia Pacific (Singapore and New Zealand). The candidate must have extensive experience of working on software and SAAS and AI agreements, for example, customer, partner, reseller, license and service agreements. It would also be useful if the candidate has experience of working in the gaming sector. The candidate must have strong knowledge of data protection and privacy laws including GDPR, Swiss Data Protection laws, United Kingdom Data Protection Laws, Spanish Data Protection Laws, Russian Data Protection laws, California Data Protection laws, and New Zealand Data Protection laws. Additionally the preferred candidate will have strong knowledge of consumer and online and digital laws in these jurisdictions. The candidate will have advised on and helped to implement international privacy and data protection programs. Knowledge and experience of providing legal representation requirements for non\\-EU businesses active in the EU market is preferred. The candidate must have strong corporate transactional experience including advising on company structures, shareholder agreements, founder agreements, investment agreements. The candidate must also have some M\\\&A experience. The candidate must have extensive commercial law experience particularly complex international commercial and intellectual property licensing agreements. The preferred candidate will have worked as a lawyer in at least 3 European countries, with preference given to experience in Switzerland, Spain, England, Cyprus and Russia. The preferred candidate will be qualified in at least two European jurisdictions with preference to candidates who are qualified to practice law in at least two of Switzerland, Spain, England/Wales, Russia and Cyprus. The preferred candidate must have a bachelor in law from a European country, a masters in law from a European country, and preferably has studied at a PhD level in law. The candidate must have data protection and privacy law qualifications from an internationally recognised body for example Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP). The preferred candidate will also have recognised qualifications in AI law. \*\*Business Development Experience\*\* This person must have extensive business development experience and a proven track record of building and maintaining existing client relationships and developing new client relationships particularly in the technology sector in Suisse romande. The candidate must have good contacts with key actors in the technology eco\\-system in Suisse romande, for example in Trust Valley, FONGIT, InnoVaud, EFPL Innovation Park, British Swiss Chamber of Commerce, Executives International, InnoSuisse, Venture Kick and Mass Challenge candidate must have good business contacts in Switzerland with large corporates and in the technology sector particularly in the Suisse romande area in Cantons Vaud and Geneva. The candidate must also have strong business contacts in the technology sector in Europe in particular the United Kingdom, Spain, Cyprus and Russia. The preferred candidate will have good business contacts in Asia Pacific, in particular New Zealand and Singapore. The candidate must have a proven record of generating new business. The candidate must have strong marketing experience and have a proven track record in content marketing in channels such as LinkedIn and in company websites. The candidate must have extensive experience in designing and delivering high\\-level legal training to non\\-lawyers for example to technology incubators, to clients and other organisations. \*\*Languages\*\* The candidate will speak and write in English to a native level. As we have an international client base additionally the preferred candidate will speak and write Russian to a business level and is committed to learning French to a business level. Additional language ability in Spanish, Portuguese or German would be an asset. \*\*AI\*\* The preferred candidate with be AI fluent and experienced in using legal AI tools in legal practice including Thomson Reuters Co\\-Counsel, Claude AI, Clio practice management software and netdocuments. !\[Logan \& Partners Sàrl\]( ) \* Logan \\\& Partners Sàrl Avenue Alexandre\\-Vinet 25 1004 Lausanne \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid8edfc5ejm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

jobs.title: Vi søker deg med hjerte for mat. mennesker og kvalitet
jobs.description:
Vi du lede et kjøkken som skaper matglede, gode måltidsopplevelser og trygg næring hver dag? Vi søker en engasjert og utviklingsorientert leder som ønsker å bidra til kvalitet, trivsel og god ressursutnyttelse. Som avdelingsleder for kjøkkenet får du ansvar for den daglige driften av kjøkkenet og blir en viktig del av ledertaemet. Du vil lede dyktige medarbeidere og videreutvikle er kjøkken som har stor betydning for pasientenes helse, livskvalitet og måltidsglede. Hos oss handler mat om mer enn ernæring. Måltidene er dagens høydepunkt for mange av våre beboere. Som kjøkkenleder får du muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell hver eneste dag.

På Nygård BBS Kjøkken vil du møte en aktiv og sammensveiset gjeng som ikke står av veien for å ta i et tak. Kjøkkenet produserer måltider til Nygård BBS, Sandefjord Medisinske Senter (SMS), Bofellesskap og Dagsenter. Vi drifter Kafé Nygård og kantinen på SMS, samt noe catering.  Kjøkkenet leverer mat til personer med sammensatte og ulike ernæringsmessige behov, og har kompetanse på formkost og dietter. Hos oss får du kombinere ledelse, fagutvikling og matglede med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Her ser du noen av de flotte medarbeiderne du vil møte:

Nygård BBS er nylig påbygd og renovert, og nyoppusset kjøkken med moderne utstyr ble åpnet i mars 2023. Sykehjemmet har 162 beboere, og ca 400 ansatte. Dette vil øke gradvis de nærmeste årene, inntil vi når 180 beboere i 2030. Sandefjord Medisinske senter har 61 sengeplasser inne korttid rehabilitering, intermediær, ØHD og palliasjon. Kjøkkenet består av disse to lokasjonene og drives med 9 årsverk inkludert avdelingsleder. Hovedkjøkkenet produserer middager etter kok/kjølprinsippet, inkludert dietter og formkost. I tillegge produseres desserter, kaker og mat til arrangementer og høytider.  I kafé og kantine selges varm og kald mat i ukedagene. Kjøkkenet leverer også bestillinger til møter og catering.

Som leder på kjøkkente har du ansvar for hele verdikjeden innen mat og servering, fra innkjøp, bestilling og lagerstyring til produksjon og distribusjon. Du har personalansvar og resultatansvar innenfor ditt område, og samarbeider tett med verneombud og tillitsvalgte i tråd med virksomhetens satsingsområde. 

Stillingen er under utvikling og det kan bli noe endringer i ansvarsområder i framtiden. 

Mer om Nygård BBS, Sandefjrod Medisinske senter og seksjon Bo- og behandlingssenter kan du lese lenger nede i annonsen. 

Stillingsinformasjon

Stillingsstørrelse: 100%Stillingstype: FastArbeidstid: Per tiden dagtidStilling ledig fra: Etter avtale

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Daglig og administrativ ledelse av kjøkkenet
  • Personalansvar for kjøkkenets medarbeidere
  • Planlegging og oppfølging av produksjon, bemanning og drift
  • Sikre god kvalitet, matsikkerhet og ernæringsfaglige standarder
  • Budsjett- og økonomioppfølging
  • Bidra til utvikling av tjenester, arbeidsprosesser og måltidskonsepter
  • Nært samarbeide og aktiv involvering av verneombud og tillitsvalgt
  • Samarbeide tett med avdelinger, ledere, beboere og pårørende

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant utdanning innen matfag, ernæring eller kokkefag
  • Ledererfaring eller ønske om å ta steget imm i en lederrolle
  • Gjerne videreutdanning innen ledelse
  • God forståelse for økonomi, drift og ressursstyring
  • Er strukturert, tydelig og løsningsorientert
  • Evner å motivere medarbeidere og skape et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Interesse for ernæring og måltidenes betydning i eldreomsorgen
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter
  • Førerkort for bil

Vi tilbyr

  • En spennende lederstilling med stor påvirkningsmulighet
  • Et viktig samfunnsoppdrag med fokus på kvalitet og matglede
  • Dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere
  • Mulighet til å utvikle og forme fremtidens kjøkkentjenester
  • Lederstøtte og faglige utviklingsmuligheter
  • Bedriftsidrettslag med bredt utvalg og sosiale treff
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Personalhytter

Lønn og pensjon

Stillingen er plassert i kommunens lønnsregulativ i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale og i stillingskode 9453.

Årslønn i stillingen er kr 700 000 for full stilling.

All tidligere privat og offentlig tjeneste godskrives i lønnsansienniteten.

Som ansatt er du medlem av Sandefjord kommunale pensjonskasse og trekkes 2 % i arbeidstakerandel. Arbeidsgiverandelen er p.t. på ca 10 %.

Andre opplysninger

  • Gjensidig prøvetid er 6 måneder. Der arbeidsforholdet er på under 12 mnd, er prøvetiden halvparten av tilsettingstiden.
  • For stillinger der det er krav om politiattest, må godkjent attest fremvises før ansettelse.
  • Kommunen følger offentlighetsloven § 25 ved eventuell offentliggjøring av søkerliste.
  • For å ivareta habilitet og et godt arbeidsmiljø, bør nære relasjoner mellom ansatte på samme tjenestested unngås, særlig der det foreligger over- eller underordetforhold, jf kommunens etiske reglement. 
  • Du skal ikke sende inn vitnemål og attester i forbindelse med søknaden, vi etterspør dette senere i prosessen.

Mangfold og inkludering

Sandefjord kommune arbeider for et mangfoldig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø, og ønsker medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, bakgrunn og erfaring. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, etnisitet, religion, funksjonsevne eller seksuell orientering. Ved ellers like kvalifikasjoner kan søkere av det underrepresenterte kjønnet bli prioritert, i tråd med likestillings‑ og diskrimineringsloven.

Om Nygård BBS, Sandefjord Medisinske Senter og seksjon Bo- og behandlingssentre

Nygård BBS har i dag 162 plasser fordelt på 8 avdelinger. I løpet av de nærmeste årene øker dette til 180 plasser fordelt på 9 avdelinger. De ulike avdelingene er tilrettelagt for personer med demens og somatisk sykdom, med noen plasser for rullerende avlastning. Bygget er nyrenovert i kombinasjon med nybygg og det er satset på teknologi som en naturlig del i utviklingen av tjenesten. Vi har fokus på fagutvikling, miljøarbeid og aktivitet gjennom å se og tilrettelegge for den enkelte beboers behov. Gruppeaktiviteter tilbys i samarbeid med miljøarbeidere og frivillige. Vårt eget produksjonskjøkken har en viktig rolle i arbeidet med matglede og ernæring. Lege er tilknyttet senteret.

Sandefjord Medisinske senter har tre døgnavdelinger som tar imot pasienter fra både spesialisthelsetjenesten og hjemmet, for korttidsopphold med oppfølging, behandling og rehabilitering. I samme bygning holder også legevakt, fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten og lærings- og mestringssenteret til. Auditorium og møterom innbyr til kurs- og møtevirksomhet. Kjøkkenet leverer mat til døgnavdelingene, drifter kantine, møtemat og catering. 

Seksjon bo- og behandlingssentre i Sandefjord kommune består av flere enheter med pasienter på forskjellig omsorgsnivå innen eldreomsorg. Bo- og behandlingssentre er lokalisert med ett i Andebu, ett i Stokke, to i Sandefjord samt  Sandefjord Medisinske senter og tre bofellesskap for mennesker med demenssykdom i Sandefjord. Til sammen 324 plasser fordelt på korttid/avlastning og langtidsplasser. Bo- og behandlingssenterne har egne produksjonskjøkken. Sandefjord kommune er vertskommune for Utviklingssenter for sykehjem og hjemmetjenester i Vestfold, og har stort fokus på fagutvikling og tjenesteutvikling innen eldreomsorgen i kommunen.

Er dette en stilling som gir deg lyst til å flytte til Sandefjord?

Bor du ikke i Sandefjord og tenker at dette er interessant for deg, så legger vi ved et par linker til aktuell informasjon om Sandefjord kommune, i tillegg til at du har link til kommunens egne nettsider tilgjengelig i utlysningen.

Klikkbare lenker:Tenk SandefjordSandefjord kommune | FacebookForesatteportalen i Sandefjord kommuneSandefjord kommune på YouTube

Til informasjon: Sandefjord kommune ønsker ikke tilbud fra rekrutteringsbyråer for innleie. Kommunens policy er å ansette medarbeidere.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sandefjord er en kommune med stor tilflytting, rask ekspansjon og spennende utviklingsmuligheter. Sandefjord kommune er den største kommunen i regionen Vestfold og Telemark. Vi har over 67 000 innbyggere og over 5000 ansatte. Sandefjord ligger sentralt i Vestfold, med Oslo kun litt over en time unna. Det er særdeles gode forbindelser til inn- og utland via fly, tog, buss og båt. Kommunen har flott natur, et aktivt kulturliv og er et godt sted å bo. Se gjerne www.sandefjord.kommune.no for mer informasjon. Tilgjengelighetserklæring for EasyCruit: https://uustatus.no/nb/erklaringer/publisert/ebb3d730-a127-45ce-b036-04cb8e1205cb

jobs.title: Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

As Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders) in our Structures Team, you will lead the structural design and development of VÆRIDION’s fuselage, door, and windows work packages for our CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

Your mission is to guide a small team of engineers in delivering lightweight, manufacturable, certifiable, and production-ready structural solutions. You will be responsible for technical direction, work-package execution, team coordination, cross-functional alignment, and delivery quality within your scope.

This role combines hands-on aircraft structures expertise with strong leadership. You will not only execute engineering work yourself, but also enable others, remove blockers, anticipate risks, and represent the Structures function in internal and external discussions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead complete fuselage, doors, and windows work packages independently.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of structures engineers.

  • Set priorities, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure high-quality delivery.

  • Own technical coordination for fuselage structures, door surrounds, window cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, and installations.

  • Drive design maturity from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production release.

  • Anticipate and mitigate technical, schedule, manufacturing, supplier, and certification risks.

  • Represent Structures in cross-functional meetings, design reviews, supplier reviews, and certification discussions.

  • Align stakeholders across Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Quality, Procurement, and external partners.

  • Challenge assumptions, bring practical design improvements, and help the team make sound technical decisions.

  • Review key engineering outputs, including CAD models, drawings, interface definitions, and design documentation.

  • Build team capability by improving methods, standards, templates, and ways of working.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience.

  • Proven experience leading technical work packages and coordinating engineering teams.

  • Strong leadership skills: clear communication, prioritization, decision-making, conflict resolution, and team development.

  • Experience in at least two full aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong experience with metallic fuselage structures, aircraft doors, windows, cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, or major airframe assemblies.

  • Strong understanding of metallic and composite aircraft structures, load paths, manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and certification constraints.

  • Deep proficiency in CATIA V5 or 3DX and configuration-controlled design data.

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23.

  • Ability to anticipate risks, create clarity, align stakeholders, and deliver results through others.

  • Confidence to represent the function internally and externally.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.description:
What we’re all about.

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity

Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days.

You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests.

Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value.

The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner.

  • Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports.

  • Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams.

  • Planning, coordinating and running annual Board offsite meetings.

  • Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress.

  • Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel.

  • Handling the inevitable last-minute juggling that comes with supporting a team of busy, dedicated senior people.

Requirements

What you’ll bring.

  • Organized and proactive: you juggle multiple projects at once without dropping any balls, take responsibility and create opportunity.

  • Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen.

  • Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across.

  • Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients.

  • Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support.

  • Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are.

jobs.title: Security and Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery

  • Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance

  • Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through

  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment

  • Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

 

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

jobs.description:

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

  • Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. jobs.title: Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start ab sofort · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office

Starte deine Sales-Karriere bei Pennylane in Berlin. Als Junior Sales Manager (intern: Sales Development Representative) arbeitest du 100 % Inbound: Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

  • 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

  • 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg

  • Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört

  • Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

  • Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

  • Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?

Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 3 Monate

  • Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen

  • Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen

Monat 4 bis 8

  • Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads

  • Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter

Und danach …

  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

  • Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

  • Du möchtest im Vertrieb durchstarten – als Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in. Erste Erfahrungen im Inside Sales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder Kundenservice sind willkommen, etwa als Junior Sales Manager, Sales Development Representative (SDR) oder Business Development Representative (BDR). Auch aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel bringst du wertvolle Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit. Vertriebserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und sprichst gern mit Unternehmer:innen

  • Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – am Telefon und schriftlich

  • Du bist organisiert, arbeitest gern mit Zielen und magst strukturierte Prozesse

  • Du willst lernen, nimmst Feedback gern an und bleibst beim Nachfassen dran – auch wenn es mal nicht sofort klappt

  • Du führst auf Deutsch souverän telefonische Beratungsgespräche und schreibst verständliche geschäftliche E-Mails; auf Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache) fühlst du dich sicher

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM (idealerweise Salesforce) ist ein Plus

Was wir bieten

  • 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start ab sofort

  • 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel

  • 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

  • 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

  • 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

  • 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

  • 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

  • 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

  2. Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

  3. Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – keine Vorbereitung nötig; wir schauen auf Gesprächsführung und Lernfähigkeit, nicht auf Produktwissen

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. Warum wir dich suchen

Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt.

Deine Mission

Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

  • Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion.

  • Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

  • GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen

  • Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

  • Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern

  • Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

  • Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

  • Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

  • Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung.

  • Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels.

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

  • Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta.

  • Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst.

  • Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

  • 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

  • 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg

  • Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört

  • Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

  • Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

  • Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?

Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 3 Monate

  • Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen

  • Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen

Monat 4 bis 8

  • Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads

  • Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter

Und danach …

  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

  • Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

  • Du möchtest im Vertrieb durchstarten – als Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in. Erste Erfahrungen im Inside Sales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder Kundenservice sind willkommen, etwa als Junior Sales Manager, Sales Development Representative (SDR) oder Business Development Representative (BDR). Auch aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel bringst du wertvolle Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit. Vertriebserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und sprichst gern mit Unternehmer:innen

  • Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – am Telefon und schriftlich

  • Du bist organisiert, arbeitest gern mit Zielen und magst strukturierte Prozesse

  • Du willst lernen, nimmst Feedback gern an und bleibst beim Nachfassen dran – auch wenn es mal nicht sofort klappt

  • Du führst auf Deutsch souverän telefonische Beratungsgespräche und schreibst verständliche geschäftliche E-Mails; auf Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache) fühlst du dich sicher

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM (idealerweise Salesforce) ist ein Plus

Was wir bieten

  • 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start ab sofort

  • 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel

  • 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

  • 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

  • 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

  • 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

  • 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

  • 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

  2. Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

  3. Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – keine Vorbereitung nötig; wir schauen auf Gesprächsführung und Lernfähigkeit, nicht auf Produktwissen

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients

  • Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA

  • Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio

  • Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation

  • Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations

  • Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager

  • Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them

  • Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently

  • Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements

  • Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite

  • Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems

  • Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work

 

Benefits

 

  • Salary: £35,000 - £45,000

  • Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books


Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager - Website & Conversion
jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model
