jobs.title: Pullup Entertainment - Cdi - Juriste Senior - Dpo & Conformite Ia (H/F/Nb)
jobs.description:
Chez PulluP Entertainment, nous avons pour but d’offrir aux joueurs du monde entier des expériences uniques.

Notre ligne éditoriale se démarque grâce à des concepts innovants, des gameplays alternatifs et des univers originaux qui transcendent les frontières du jeu vidéo.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un·e Juriste Senior - DPO & Conformité IA.

Vos missions :

Rattaché·e à la Directrice Juridique Groupe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le déploiement et l'animation du dispositif de conformité du groupe PulluP. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe.

À ce titre, vous intervenez notamment sur les missions suivantes :

1) Gouvernance & Suivi de la Conformité

  • Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route de conformité (Data & IA) et en assurer le déploiement à l'échelle du Groupe.

  • Rédiger, déployer et tenir à jour l'ensemble des politiques et documents légaux liés à la Data et à l'IA (Privacy Policies, politiques cookies, chartes IA internes, CGU, procédures de gestion de crise), en tenant compte des spécificités du secteur du jeu vidéo (données de mineurs, AdTech, outils anti-triche).

  • Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP.

  • Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.).

  • Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe.

2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel

  • Gérer la conformité des traitements de données au quotidien : tenue et mise à jour du registre, réalisation des analyses d'impact (AIPD), audits internes, identification des risques et suivi des plans de remédiation.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DSI/RSSI) sur la sécurisation des données pour assurer la gestion des incidents de sécurité (incluant la préparation des notifications aux autorités) dans les délais impartis.

  • Traiter les demandes d'exercice de droits dans les délais impartis.

  • Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans la mise œuvre de projet impliquant le traitement de données personnelles en procédant à l'évaluation des impacts et risques associés (privacy by design).

3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act)

  • Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans le déploiement de leurs projets d'Intelligence Artificielle en procédant à l'évaluation des risques associés (compliance by design).

  • Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables.

4) Conseil, Négociation & Sensibilisation

  • Accompagnement des équipes Marketing sur les sujets AdTech (cookies, pixels, SDK, ciblage publicitaire, etc.).

  • Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires.

  • Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de formation à destination des différentes directions du groupe.


Ce que l’on attend de vous :

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master 2 en droit du numérique, droit des nouvelles technologies, protection des données et/ou spécialisation DPO et disposez d’une expérience confirmée de 7 ans minimum en protection des données (une expérience en tant que DPO ou DPO adjoint est fortement appréciée).

  • L'obtention d'une certification reconnue (type IAPP : CIPP/E, CIPM) constitue un véritable atout.

  • Vous disposez d’une excellente maîtrise opérationnelle du RGPD et des réglementations liées à la protection des données, et d’une connaissance pratique des réglementations internationales (CCPA/CPRA, UK GDPR, PIPEDA, etc.).

  • Vous maîtrisez des enjeux liés au traitement des données des mineurs et aux mécanismes de vérification d'âge.

  • Vous faites preuve de solides connaissances de la réglementation relative à l’encadrement de l’IA (AI Act / RIA) et des enjeux de gouvernance des systèmes d'IA.

  • Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral (rédaction et négociation autonome de contrats).

  • Vous disposez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles.

Ce que l’on dit de vous :

  • Vous faites montre d’une approche par les risques affirmée, pragmatique et orientée business (capacité à hiérarchiser les enjeux et à formuler des réponses opérationnelles proportionnées).

  • Vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre rigueur et votre capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et démontrez une forte autonomie dans la gestion des dossiers.

  • Vous faites preuve de pédagogie et savez expliquer et vulgariser des concepts juridiques complexes de manière claire auprès d’interlocuteurs variés (techniques, métiers, Direction).

  • Vos aptitudes relationnelles et de communication seront des atouts clés pour réussir dans ce poste.

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Un environnement de travail structuré et respectueux où l’autonomie est valorisée ;

  • Une culture d’excellence soutenue par un programme interne de formations régulières (techniques, managériales, certifications), adapté aux besoins de chaque collaborateur ;

  • Une reconnaissance et valorisation du travail grâce à nos entretiens annuels et professionnels, ouvrant de réelles perspectives d’évolution et de mobilité interne au sein du Groupe ;

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

jobs.title: Ingénieur conception mécanique et intégration d'instruments spatiaux (f/h) (H/F)
jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur Conception Mécanique et Intégration d'Instruments Spatiaux (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Bureau d'Études Satellites basé à Toulouse, France. Vos missions : Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des satellites scientifiques et d'observation de la Terre de nouvelle génération. Au sein du département d'ingénierie mécanique et thermique, vous serez impliqué(e) dans les études d'aménagement et d'intégration physique des charges utiles optiques et radiofréquences, visant à garantir l'optimisation architecturale et le respect des exigences de vol spatial. Vos responsabilités : 1. Architecture mécanique et études d'aménagement (Accommodation) Piloter les études d'implantation spatiale des instruments (optiques et radiofréquences) en tenant compte des contraintes de masse, de volume, thermiques et opérationnelles.  Définir et optimiser l'agencement des équipements : placement des boîtiers, cheminement des faisceaux de câblage (harness) et intégration des sous-ensembles optiques de précision.  Définir et gérer les interfaces mécaniques et thermiques entre la plateforme du satellite et les différents sous-systèmes. 2. Justification technique, tolérancement et industrialisation Réaliser les analyses d'évaluation de masse, centrage et inertie (MCI) ainsi que les chaînes de cotes et tolérancements pour garantir la faisabilité industrielle.  Rédiger la documentation technique de référence : dossiers de conception, rapports d'aménagement et documents de contrôle d'interfaces (ICD - Interface Control Document ).  Présenter et défendre les solutions techniques lors des revues formelles de conception face aux clients et partenaires institutionnels. 3. Coordination métier et pilotage transversal Assurer l'interface technique avec les spécialistes des autres disciplines (thermique, électrique, calcul de structures) et les équipes d'assemblage, intégration et essais (AIT - Assembly, Integration and Testing ).  Encadrer techniquement les lots de travaux sous-traités ( Work Packages ) dans le respect des jalons du projet.  Garantir le suivi des coûts, des plannings et de la qualité des livrables selon les processus du bureau d'études et de la continuité numérique (DDMS - Digital Design, Manufacturing and Services ). Votre profil : OBLIGATOIRE : Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.  Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l'IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (.1.2.2.1). jobs.title: Flexi animator karting
jobs.description:
Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?

Je start je dag met een controle van de werkruimte en zorgt ervoor dat alles netjes en klaarstaat voor de klanten. Je vult de frigo's aan, controleert of de karts volledig opgeladen zijn en treft de nodige voorbereidingen voor de eerste onthalen van de dag.

Zodra de eerste klanten arriveren, verwelkom je hen met een glimlach. Je helpt klanten aan de bar, geeft hen de nodige uitleg over hun bezoek en zorgt ervoor dat zij goed geïnformeerd aan hun race kunnen beginnen. Dankzij jouw klantgerichte aanpak beleven bezoekers een vlotte en aangename ervaring.

Doorheen de dag sta je klaar om vragen te beantwoorden, klanten verder te helpen en ervoor te zorgen dat alles op rolletjes loopt. Aan het einde van je werkdag sluit je de activiteiten netjes af, zorg je voor de nodige opkuis en laat je de werkplek verzorgd achter voor je collega's.

  • Je mag als flexi werken
  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer of een betrouwbare manier om je vlot en stipt naar de locatie te verplaatsen.
  • Je hebt een goede tot vloeiende kennis van het Nederlands, zodat je vlot kunt communiceren met zowel klanten als collega's.
  • Je bent computervaardig en hebt voldoende technisch inzicht om te werken met reservatiesystemen en klanten correct op te starten.
  • Je bent veel beschikbaar in het weekend en eventueel op woensdagen

jobs.description: Vill du bygga ett nytt affärsområde med frihet att sätta riktningen, mandat att rekrytera ditt team och verktyg som ger dig ett försprång?Talangbron är specialister på search, rekrytering och interim inom områden där konkurrensen om kompetensen är som hårdast. Här finns korta beslutsvägar, stöd i vardagen och en gemensam vilja att bygga långsiktigt.Till din hjälp har du våra egenutvecklade system. De bevakar marknaden, tar hand om delar av grundarbetet och förbereder underlag, så att du kan lägga mer tid på kundrelationer, kandidatbedömning och ledarskap. Plattformen utvecklas varje vecka, och dina idéer kan snabbt bli en del av hur vi arbetar.Affärsområdet omfattar search, rekrytering och interim för roller som utvecklare, arkitekter, specialister inom IT-säkerhet, data och AI samt IT-chefer och CTO:er.Vem är du?Vi söker dig som har:    Gedigen erfarenhet av rekrytering och är van att både utveckla kundaffärer och själv leverera uppdrag    Ett starkt nätverk på kund - och kandidatsidan    Erfarenhet av att leda ett team eller dokumenterat starka resultat inom egen försäljning    En tydlig ambition att bygga och leda ett teamDet är meriterande om du har erfarenhet och nätverk inom IT & Tech, gärna bland IT-chefer och CTO:er. Du tycker om att öppna dörrar och skapa affärer, samtidigt som du får energi av att utveckla människor och se andra lyckas.Hos oss förändras verktygen och arbetssätten löpande. Du gillar att testa nya möjligheter och vill använda AI i ditt arbete. Du behöver inte vara utvecklare, men du vill vara med och påverka hur tekniken kan göra rekrytering bättre.Vi är ett litet, prestigelöst team med högt i tak. Vi vill bygga ett bolag där människor trivs, har roligt och kan göra ett riktigt bra jobb tillsammans.Det här erbjuder vi ⭐    Mandat att bygga. Du får ansvar för ett eget affärsområde och möjlighet att forma både teamet och arbetssätten.    En långsiktig satsning. Ägare, styrelse och grundarteam står bakom etableringen, med resurser och tålamod att skapa rätt förutsättningar från början.    Verktyg som utvecklas med verksamheten. Våra egenutvecklade system ger dig stöd i det dagliga arbetet och möjlighet att påverka vad vi bygger härnäst.    Närhet till besluten. Du arbetar direkt med grundarteamet och kan snabbt omsätta idéer i praktiken.    Ersättning kopplad till det du bygger. Du får fast lön och provision för egen försäljning samt bonus kopplad till affärsområdets resultat.Om TalangbronFör ett par år sedan valde vi att ställa om Talangbron. Vi lämnade vårdbemanning för att fokusera på specialistrekrytering och interim, och byggde våra egna system från grunden. Omställningen innebar lägre omsättning på kort sikt, men gav oss ett tydligare fokus och en starkare grund för nästa steg. Vi fortsätter att utveckla plattformen varje vecka.I dag arbetar vi med ledande aktörer inom bl.a. vård, life science och hälsa i Sverige och Norge. Nu breddar vi verksamheten till fler specialistområden. Vi kombinerar teknikens räckvidd med människors erfarenhet och omdöme för att hitta rätt kompetens och bedöma vad som fungerar i varje organisation.Om anställningen    Omfattning: Heltid    Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning    Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse    Lön: Fast lön samt provision eller bonus kopplad till affärsområdets resultat    Placering: Roslagsgatan 35Vill du bygga med oss? 🚀Vi ser fram emot att höra om din erfarenhet, ditt nätverk och vad du vill bygga hos Talangbron.Kommer du från en annan nisch än IT & Tech? Hör gärna av dig ändå. Vi är nyfikna på fler specialistområden och på dig som vill utveckla dem tillsammans med oss.Vi gör urval löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Dans le respect de la loi, de la philosophie de soins et de l'éthique, la mission principale de l’aide-soignant est de soutenir l’infirmier en chef ou le chef opérationnel et son équipe dans la prise en charge globale du patient.

Plus concrètement, vos missions en tant qu’ Aide-Soignant sont :

  • Transporter les patients en préopératoire (brancardage)
  • Effectuer des tâches soignantes et infirmières déléguées dans les limites légales autorisées : monitoring des patients, observation des modifications de symptômes ou réactions du patient, procure le matériel adapté et porte attention à ce que les chariots disposent de matériel suffisant
  • Prendre en charge les patients : il/elle veille à son confort, fait l’accueil des nouveaux patients, écoute et informe sur les soins effectués
  • Respecter les règles d’hygiène et maintenir de l’ordre dans les salles
  • Apporter une aide administrative et informer l’équipe des changements via des transmissions écrites et orales
  • Prodiguer des soins de qualité en toute sécurité dans le respect du patient
  • Vous nouez des contacts chaleureux avec les patients et vous les rassurez
  • Vous participez à la vie quotidienne du service :
  • Rangement du matériel en provenance du service de stérilisation
  • Préparation du matériel nécessaire aux interventions
  • Réalisations des commandes

Profil recherché :

  • Posséder un diplôme d’Aide-Soignant
  • Posséder la formation complémentaire d’Aide-Soignant (150h) est obligatoire 
  • Être en possession du VISA aide-soignant(e)
  • Posséder une expérience en milieu hospitalier est un réel atout
  • Satisfaire aux conditions légales de bilinguisme : vous avez de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue nationale ou vous êtes disposé à les acquérir (cours de langues organisés en interne sur le temps de travail, possibilité d’obtenir une prime de bilinguisme SELOR de 150€ bruts sous réserve de la remise du Selor Art. 10)
  • Satisfaire à l’entretien de sélection
  • Satisfaire aux conditions du profil.

Qualités requises :

  • Vous travaillez de façon autonome et vous êtes capable de demander de l’aide
  • Vous êtes flexible et appréciez les changements
  • Vous êtes empathique vis-à-vis des patients
  • Vous privilégiez la concertation et le dialogue multidisciplinaire
  • Vous avez un sens aigu de la communication et de l’écoute
  • Vous êtes diplomate et communiquez avec tact
  • Vous faites preuve de créativité
  • Vous êtes ouvert au changement et participez à l'innovation dans votre service.

Le CHU Saint-Pierre est un hôpital public et universitaire de référence, offrant des soins de grande qualité accessibles à tous.

Dans ce cadre, il relève quotidiennement les défis de la santé publique tout en déclinant son caractère universitaire via une implication active dans l’enseignement et la recherche.

Les chiffres clés qui caractérisent l’hôpital sont les suivants :

  • 450.000 consultations/an
  • 45.000 admissions/an
  • 23.000 opérations chirurgicales/an
  • 85.000 passages aux urgences/an
  • 2900 accouchements/an
  • 3200 collaborateurs dont 400 médecins

Le respect, l’innovation, l’engagement, la qualité et la solidarité sont les valeurs clés de l’hôpital. Toutes et tous s’attèlent à placer le patient au centre de leur action. Les réponses aux réalités sociales, la tolérance, le libre-examen et la capacité à se mobiliser au quotidien pour les patients, bruxellois et non-bruxellois, sont les moteurs de ses actions.

La quête de l’excellence en médecine de pointe et l’approche multidisciplinaire, font de l’hôpital une référence sur le plan national.

Le CHU St Pierre travaille également en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires comme les médecins généralistes, médecins spécialistes référents, les CPAS et les autres institutions d’aides et de soins en Région bruxelloise.

Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est à la fois faire partie d’un hôpital ancré dans la Ville depuis plusieurs siècles et d’un réseau hospitalier moderne en développement rapide, CHORUS, plus grand réseau hospitalier en Belgique. Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est faire partie d’un groupe soudé, soutenant, au sein duquel chaque personne a sa place, afin d’offrir un service optimal. La satisfaction de nos patients et notre bien-être au travail sont nos priorités.

jobs.description: Digitalisaatio ja tietohallintoryhmä vastaa Tampereen kaupungin ICT-palvelujen järjestämisestä ja strategisesta kehittämisestä. Meillä työskentelet digitalisaation ytimessä ja vaikutat merkittävästi tulevaisuuden Tampereen toimintatapoihin ja edellytyksiin hyödyntää dataa palveluiden ja toiminnan kehittämisessä. Data ja sen saatavuuden edistäminen ovat hyvin merkittävässä roolissa, kun tuemme työssämme myös kaupungin eri kehitysohjelmien kautta tapahtuvaa kehittämistä. Tampereella pääset toimimaan yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävien ja hyvin laaja-alaisten data-aineistojen parissa sekä hyödyntämään työssäsi moderneja teknologiaratkaisuja.Haemme data-ammattilaista vakituiseen toimeen työskentelemään Data- ja tekoälypalvelut -tiimissä 1.12.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.Ympärilläsi sinulla on tiimi innostuneita ja osaavia asiantuntijoita, joiden tukeen voit luottaa. jobs.title: Hankintapäällikkö / Hankintapalvelut
jobs.description: Tampereen kaupunki hankkii vuosittain palveluita, urakoita ja tuotteita yli 600 miljoonalla eurolla. Hankinnat ovat keskeinen keino viedä Tekemisen kaupunki -strategiaa käytäntöön, ja niitä ohjaavat kaupungin hankinnan strategiset painopisteet: taloudellinen vakaus, vaikuttava uudistuminen, ekologinen ja sosiaalinen kestävyys sekä toimintavarmuus. jobs.title: Site Manager – Vi søker deg som setter mennesker først!
jobs.description:
For oss handler god ledelse om mer enn drift, rutiner og resultater. Det handler om mennesker.

Vi ser etter en Site Manager som har service i ryggmargen, et sterkt personlig driv og et genuint ønske om å skape et sted der både medarbeidere og gjester trives.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:

  • Har service som personlighet, ikke bare som arbeidsoppgave.

  • Har høy grad av selvledelse, ansvarsfølelse og gjennomføringsevne.

  • Har et naturlig ønske om å lykkes og levere gode resultater.

  • Oppriktig gleder deg over å se andre mennesker trives og lykkes.

  • Er positiv, løsningsorientert og trygg i møte med mennesker.

  • Evner å kombinere struktur og profesjonalitet med varme og personlighet.

  • Forstår at godt lederskap handler om å løfte andre.

Vi er opptatt av hvem du er, ikke bare hva du har gjort.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Mennesker og kultur

Være en synlig, tilstedeværende og inkluderende leder.

Skape et arbeidsmiljø der mennesker føler seg sett, verdsatt og motivert.

Følge opp, utvikle og inspirere medarbeidere.

Bygge en kultur preget av samarbeid, arbeidsglede og stolthet.

Være en god rollemodell for selskapets verdier.

Rekruttering, opplæring og onboarding av nye medarbeidere, dersom stillingen har personalansvar.

Service og opplevelser

Sikre at kunder, gjester og samarbeidspartnere blir møtt med ekte engasjement og god service.

Skape opplevelser som gjør at mennesker ønsker å komme tilbake.

Være proaktiv og se behov før de oppstår.

Håndtere tilbakemeldinger og utfordringer med profesjonalitet og løsningsvilje.

Bidra til at service ikke bare er noe vi leverer, men noe vi er.

Drift og resultater

Ha det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften av lokasjonen.

Sikre kvalitet, struktur og gode rutiner.

Følge opp mål, resultater og relevante nøkkeltall.

Planlegge bemanning og ressursbruk.

Sørge for at lokasjonen til enhver tid fremstår innbydende og profesjonell.

Identifisere forbedringsmuligheter og gjennomføre tiltak.

Ta ansvar for HMS, internkontroll og etterlevelse av rutiner.

Vi tilbyr

Hva tilbyr vi?

  • En arbeidsplass med mennesker i fokus -- hvor trivsel, arbeidsglede og gode relasjoner står sentralt.

  • Frihet under ansvar -- vi har tillit til menneskene våre og gir rom for selvstendighet, initiativ og eierskap.

  • Muligheten til å påvirke -- du får en sentral rolle i å utvikle både lokasjonen, kulturen og menneskene rundt deg.

  • Personlig og faglig utvikling -- vi ønsker at du skal vokse, utfordre deg selv og lykkes sammen med oss.

  • Et miljø med ambisjoner -- vi heier på hverandre, setter oss mål og feirer gode resultater sammen.

  • En kultur der vi løfter hverandre -- vi tror at når mennesker trives, skapes også de beste opplevelsene og resultatene.

  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag -- hvor du får bruke både dine menneskelige egenskaper og dine lederevner.

Hos oss får du ikke bare ansvar for en lokasjon. Du får muligheten til å skape et sted hvor mennesker ønsker å være, medarbeidere ønsker å jobbe, og hvor gode opplevelser skapes hver eneste dag.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Om oss

Vi er en virksomhet med mennesker i fokus og en sterk tro på at gode opplevelser skapes av mennesker som trives.

For oss er service mer enn en arbeidsoppgave -- det er en holdning og en del av hvem vi er. Vi brenner for å skape trivsel, bygge gode relasjoner og levere kvalitet i alt vi gjør.

Vi verdsetter engasjement, eierskap og viljen til å lykkes. Hos oss heier vi på hverandre, tar ansvar og tror at de beste resultatene skapes sammen.

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager | Regio Noord-Holland

  • Je analyseert bestaande bedrijfsprocessen, identificeert verbeterpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete actieplannen

jobs.title: Teamlead IT Service Management

Je waakt over een permanente vorming van vaardigheden zodat de expertise binnen de afdeling verder ontwikkeld kan worden. Je verzekert dat kennis geborgen en gedeeld wordt en zorgt voor een billijke werkverdeling.  Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directeur ICT en maakt deel uit van het ICT-management waar je mee richting geeft aan de strategie van de directie ICT.  Je stemt regelmatig af met interne stakeholders (PMO, juridische dienst, boekhouding, …) om de samenwerking te verbeteren.  Je bouwt goede relaties op met de externe leveranciers en partners en superviseert de kwaliteit van hun dienstverlening.  Je neemt actief deel aan synergie-initiatieven binnen de federale overheid in je competentiedomeinen.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

  • Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
  • Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
  • Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
  • Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
  • Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)

Access and security

  • Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
  • Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)

Hardware and lifecycle

  • Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
  • Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
  • Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
  • Tickets, escalation and coordination
  • Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
  • Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
  • Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
  • Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
  • Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)

You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
  • At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
  • Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
  • Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
  • Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity

Assets

  • Knowledge of Arabic
  • Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
  • Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
  • IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)

Soft skills

  • Customer focus and service mindset
  • Autonomy and rigour in incident management
  • Clear communication with non-technical users
  • Hands-on, proactive attitude

jobs.title: Onsite IT Support Technician

  • ITIL V4 Foundation Certification (recommended);

  • Team Player and Analytical Thinking;
  • Open and positive personality and ability to manage stress effectively;
  • Customer oriented (Service awareness) with good interpersonal and communication skills;
  • Able to adapt in a fast-evolving technology environment and ability to learn;
  • Able to assume day to day responsibilities generating specific deliverables;
  • Relationship-builder, at ease with people and capable of quickly building trust;
  • Language skills: Proficiency in local language and a good level of English.

jobs.title: Chef gerant -38u
jobs.description:
Als gerant in Antwerpen Edegem ben je bij Sodexo verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse organisatie en werking van de cateringactiviteiten op een grote ziekenhuislocatie. Je komt terecht in een dynamische omgeving met verschillende keukens en activiteiten, waaronder patiëntenmaaltijden, catering voor bezoekers en medewerkers en diverse bijkomende cateringaanvragen.

Als siteverantwoordelijke ben jij het centrale aanspreekpunt voor de klant en zorg je ervoor dat alle activiteiten op de site efficiënt, kwalitatief en volgens de gemaakte afspraken verlopen.

  • Dagelijks aanspreekpunt: Je bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor de klant en de verschillende stakeholders op de site. Je neemt deel aan vergaderingen met de klant, volgt vragen en aanvragen op en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken correct worden vertaald naar de operationele werking. Je bent het gezicht van Sodexo onsite en rapporteert aan de cluster manager.
  • Organisatie en coördinatie: Je staat in voor de dagelijkse organisatie en planning van de verschillende cateringactiviteiten. Je houdt het overzicht over de verschillende keukens en zorgt ervoor dat de verschillende processen goed op elkaar afgestemd zijn. Je stelt prioriteiten en zorgt ervoor dat de dagelijkse werking vlot verloopt, ook wanneer er verschillende zaken tegelijkertijd gebeuren.
  • Patiëntenmaaltijden en cateringactiviteiten: Je volgt de verschillende cateringstromen op, waaronder de productie en distributie van patiëntenmaaltijden, catering voor bezoekers en medewerkers en bijkomende cateringactiviteiten. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, service, timing en de gemaakte afspraken.
  • Administratief en financieel beheer: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de administratieve en financiële opvolging van de site. Je beheert onder andere bestellingen, facturatie, budgetten, foodcost, stock en rapportering via de interne systemen. Je volgt verschillende aanvragen en kosten op en bewaakt mee de financiële resultaten van de site. Je staat in voor de maandelijkse financiële afsluit.
  • Leidinggeven en coachen: Je stuurt, coacht en motiveert het keukenteam op de site. Je staat in voor een efficiënte personeelsplanning, ondersteunt bij evaluaties en onboarding en zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers de nodige ondersteuning krijgen om hun functie kwaliteitsvol uit te voeren.
  • Kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid: Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening en ziet erop toe dat de procedures rond voedselveiligheid, hygiëne en kwaliteit correct worden toegepast. Je volgt afwijkingen op en onderneemt actie waar nodig.
  • Extra activiteiten en aanvragen: Op deze site komen regelmatig bijkomende aanvragen en activiteiten op je af. Je zorgt voor een correcte analyse, planning en opvolging hiervan en stemt af met de verschillende betrokken partijen.
  • Veiligheidsbewustzijn: Je hanteert een zero risk mindset en doet geen compromissen op het gebied van veiligheid, of het nu gaat om jouw veiligheid, die van je collega's, consumenten, klanten of andere betrokkenen.
  • Je hebt ervaring in een leidinggevende en organisatorische functie binnen catering en grootkeuken met focus op hospitality, facility, zorg of een gelijkaardige omgeving.

Vil du være med fra starten og sette ditt preg på en helt ny Extra-butikk i Hammerfest?

I mars 2027 åpner vi Hammerfest sin nye dagligvarebutikk. Butikken blir en moderne butikk på 1000 kvm salgsflate med åpninstider fra 7-23. 

Vi ønsker oss en inspirerende og engasjert leder med relevant erfaring fra dagligvare eller varehandel. Vi håper og tror du legger stor vekt på god kundeservice, da gode kundemøter er noe av det vi ser som aller viktigst :-). Som butikksjef har du totalansvar for driften og jobber sammen med de ansatte for å beholde vårt gode arbeidsmiljø. 

Kunne du tenke deg å drive Finnmarks nyeste EXTRA butikk? Da kan dette være perfekt for deg!

Søknadsfrist: 24.10.2026 Oppstart 01.02.27

Hva kan du få hos oss?Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ledere og har også et støtteapparat som bistår våre ledere. Derfor kan vi si at vi legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs som butikksjef hos oss. Stillingen har mulighet for bonus, skaper du gode resultater får du igjen for det. I tillegg til lønn etter avtale selvsagt. Vi har telefonordning, ansattrabatter og pensjonsordning. Ikke minst får du en gjeng med utrolig engasjerte og skikkelig gode kollegaer:-). Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg.

Hva skal du gjøre?Som butikksjef har du det overordnede ansvaret for drift, resultater og personal, og vil være en synlig og motiverende leder i hverdagen. Resultater skaper du gjennom en positiv væremåte, grundig arbeid og god ledelse både i butikken og i møte med kundene. Oppgaver som rekruttering, opplæring, oppfølging og utvikling følger naturlig med stillingen. Sist men ikke minst, så er det viktig at du skaper et godt miljø og en hyggelig butikk for våre kunder å besøke, gjennom å inspirere og motivere de som jobber sammen med deg.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har erfaring som assisterende butikksjef eller butikksjef.
  • Det er viktig at du motiverer og skaper engasjement og trivsel med dine medarbeidere.
  • Du er genuint opptatt av kundeservice og bidrar til å skape gode resultater på våre løpende kundemålinger.
  • Det er ønskelig at du har relevant ledererfaring innen varehandel, gjerne dagligvarebransjen.
  • Følger kjedens konsept
  • Det å skape gode økonomiske resultater motiverer deg.

 

Spørsmål til stillingen kan rettes til personalsjef Ida Ostad på telefon: 482 03 701.

 

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da er du kanskje den nye lederen vi ser etter:-)

Coop Hammerfest SA er et medlemseid samvirkeforetak med drøyt 5700 medeiere. Selskapet har 4 butikker i Hammerfest Kommune. Vi har i dag 3 Extra og 1 Prix Butikk. Vi er ca. 75 ansatte, og forventet omsetning i 2027 er om lag 320 millioner. Vi er ett samvirkerlag i sterk vekst og ønsker deg gjerne med !

jobs.title: Team Lead - Invoices
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.

This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

  • Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

  • Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

  • Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.

This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.

You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do

Lead and grow the team

  • Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

  • Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

  • Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire

  • Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

  • Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities

  • Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

  • Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

  • Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers

  • Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

  • Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

  • Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring

  • You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

  • You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

  • You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

  • You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

  • You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

  • You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

  • You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

  • You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get

  • A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

  • Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

  • A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

  • A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

  • Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

jobs.title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
jobs.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and nurture talent pools across the manufacturing space, such as facilities managers and factory technicians, to ensure consistent delivery across high-volume pipelines.

  • Build a robust employer brand, enabling microagi to be known as a competitive employer in an emerging industrial startup ecosystem.

  • Advise the team on best practices for building out and scaling manufacturing recruiting.

  • Plan and attend industry events to further our market presence amongst the best manufacturing talent.

Requirements

  • 5+ year track record in high-volume blue-collar manufacturing hiring in innovative manufacturing environments

  • Deep network within European manufacturing and industrial talent pools

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

jobs.title: Channel Partnerships Manager, DACH
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

As Partnerships Manager, you will be joining as a core member of Airwallex’s Commercial team in EMEA and the first partnerships manager on the ground in Germany. You will be responsible for identifying and building partnerships across our core verticals of travel, SaaS and e-Commerce. We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly-driven Partnerships Manager who has 5+ years of experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth environment. We operate in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of 3 days a week working in our office in Berlin.

What You'll Be Doing...

  • You will lead, own, and develop a partnership strategy that aligns with our overall GTM in Germany

  • You will be accountable for identifying growth opportunities, testing new verticals, and building a high-quality portfolio of partners

  • You will design a scalable programme to consistently deliver growth in the partnerships channel

  • You will work closely with Marketing, Sales and Strategy teams to position Airwallex’s value proposition to partners and their clients in Germany

  • You will represent Airwallex at industry events and conferences, as well as speak on relevant panels and webinars

What You Bring...

  • Demonstrable interest in fintech, SaaS, and/or payments

  • Strong commercial instincts and a history of meeting or exceeding OKRs/KPIs consistently

  • 5+ years of work experience in partnerships, strategy, business development, or a similar role in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets (G-Suite, Looker) and building and delivering presentations for partners and clients

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in German and English.

Who You Are...

  • Results-driven - you hold yourself accountable for delivering on your targets

  • Proactive - you identify, plan, and execute against opportunities to grow, and you enjoy problem-solving to achieve those goals

  • Laser-focused - you are ruthless in spending time on the highest-impact initiatives in a fast-paced environment

  • Commercially-minded - you enjoy negotiating and you strive to achieve the best outcomes for the business

  • Relationship-oriented - you can build deep and trusting relationships with partners

  • Excellent communicator - you have excellent written and presentation skills

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

jobs.title: Product Owner Hardware (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

  • Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We are part of the WERK1 incubation program, which gives us access to apartments in the Werksviertel that never hit the open market. With enough lead time we reserve one for you before you arrive, minutes on foot from the office.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €85K – €105K • Offers Bonus

  • • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €85K – €105K • Offers Bonus

jobs.title: Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F)

  • Référence : 261828S

  • Démarrage : Immédiat

  • Durée : Long Terme - Mission de 12 mois, avec intégration en CDI client ensuite

  • Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC

  • Zone géographique : Île-de-France (78)

  • Déplacements possibles : Oui, déplacements réguliers en Normandie et dans les Hauts-de-France

Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un projet majeur du secteur nucléaire, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication spécialisé en chaudronnerie nucléaire pour accompagner la structuration, la mise en place et le pilotage d'activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés, notamment en acier inoxydable.

La mission s'articule autour de deux sites de fabrication présentant des niveaux de maturité différents : le premier dispose déjà d'une expertise et d'une expérience confirmées en fabrication INOX, tandis que le second n'a encore jamais réalisé ce type de production.

L'objectif est d'accompagner le déploiement de cette nouvelle activité sur le second site, en s'appuyant sur les savoir-faire existants, tout en assurant la coordination, la transmission des compétences et l'harmonisation des méthodes de fabrication entre les équipes.

Cette mission nécessite une forte présence terrain, une solide expertise technique en chaudronnerie nucléaire et d'excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie pour fédérer les équipes et accompagner le changement.

Missions

  • Piloter et coordonner les activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés destinés au secteur nucléaire.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'organisation des ateliers de fabrication.

  • Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle activité de fabrication INOX sur un site industriel n'ayant jamais réalisé ce type de production.

  • S'appuyer sur l'expertise du site maîtrisant déjà la fabrication INOX pour faciliter le transfert de savoir-faire et de bonnes pratiques vers le second site.

  • Assurer la coordination technique et opérationnelle entre les deux sites de fabrication.

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre les premières lignes directrices et les méthodes de fabrication.

  • Concevoir, définir et mettre en place les gabarits et outillages nécessaires à la fabrication.

  • Accompagner la fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable, notamment à partir de tôles de 4 mm d'épaisseur.

  • Assurer le pilotage opérationnel et l'accompagnement technique des équipes de fabrication.

  • Participer activement à la formation des équipes et à leur montée en compétences sur les procédés de fabrication INOX.

  • Favoriser la communication, le partage des connaissances et l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les équipes des différents sites.

  • Structurer et formaliser les méthodes de fabrication ainsi que la documentation technique associée.

  • Élaborer et mettre à jour les documents nécessaires au suivi et à l'organisation de la production.

jobs.description:
Aera Technology is a pioneer in the growing category of Decision Intelligence Platforms and a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for 2026– the technology to digitize, augment, and automate decision-making processes with AI and machine learning.   • Combine a strong foundation in data, analytics, and enterprise technology with business acumen to engage both technical and business audiences effectively.

    • About You

jobs.title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Switzerland.

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.


Accountabilities
  • Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
  • AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
  • Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
  • Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
  • Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
  • Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
  • Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
  • E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
  • Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
  • Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

    • Requirements

  • Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
  • Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
  • Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
  • Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
  • Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
  • Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
  • English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
  • Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

    • Strongly preferred:

  • Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
  • Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
  • Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
  • Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
  • Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.
  • Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.
  • Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

    • Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.

    Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.
  • Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.
  • 100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.
  • Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development.
  • Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.
  • Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.
  • AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.
  • Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

  • Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.
