jobs.title: PhD Candidates in advanced arc and friction stir welding processes for recycled aluminium
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The position is a 3-year doctoral research fellowship starting in 2027. The PhD candidate will be embedded in the welding and joining research activities of SFI FAST and will work closely with NTNU, SINTEF, and leading international industrial partners in the aluminium value chain.

The PhD position focuses on understanding the influence of impurities coming from recycled Aluminium on the weldability of different alloys. These impurities can alter the weldability, microstructure, and performance of Aluminium welds compared to the reference alloy. Solidification and liquation cracking, pore formation, heat-affected zone softening, and degradation of corrosion resistance are some examples of possible challenges. However, the knowledge is limited about any of these possible changes. Therefore, the candidate needs to provide a thorough investigation of the welding process using conventional techniques and develop new methodologies. In addition, the welding procedure adoption to enhance the performance of the alloys based on their metallurgical characteristics shall be developed. Therefore, the candidate should have a great understanding of the welding process-microstructure-performance. 

 Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department. You will be supervised by Professor Vahid Hosseini.

About the project

SFI FAST (Future Aluminium Structures) is a national Centre for Research-based Innovation (SFI) funded by the Research Council of Norway and the aluminum industry. The Centre is led by NTNU in close collaboration with SINTEF and a broad consortium of 15 leading industrial partners across the aluminium value chain. FAST runs from 2026 to 2034 and represents one of Norway’s most ambitious long-term research initiatives within aluminium materials, manufacturing technologies, and circular economy.

The primary objective of FAST is to establish the scientific and technological knowledge base required to enable the large-scale use of post-consumer scrap (PCS) aluminium in high-value, structural, and safety-critical products. FAST adopts a through-scale and through-process research methodology, integrating materials science, manufacturing processes, product and structural design, and lifecycle performance.

A key outcome of FAST is the development of the FAST Virtual Lab, a digital framework combining experimental data, physics-based models, and data-driven methods to support design, manufacturing, and decision-making across aluminium value chains.

Education and competence building are central pillars of FAST. The Centre will educate more than 18 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 100 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in aluminium research and innovation. The two positions posted here will be among the first ones to start in the Centre.

Please see the centre’s website: Future Aluminium Structures (FAST) - NTNU

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop arc welding (GTAW and GMAW) and Friction stir welding for alloys with different impurity levels to minimize welding defects and improve mechanical and corrosion performance
  • Develop knowledge in the influence of impurities on the weld’s physics, defects, microstructure, and performance
  • Thermodynamic modelling of solidification and precipitation behaviour of recycled aluminium
  • Development of weldability tests to quantify welding performance of Aluminium Alloys 
  • Advanced characterization of welded samples using Laser Confocal Microscopy, In-situ mechanical testing, SEM, FIB, and EBSD.
  • Conduct and publish high-level research in peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Work closely with industrial and academic partners and participate in relevant SFI FAST activities, including mentoring and supervising MSc students

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical engineering, Materials Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have an academically relevant background within fusion and solid-state welding, welding metallurgy, and material characterization
  • Documented strong background in:
    • Experimental welding research
    • Material characterization and testing
  • Excellent written presentation skills and oral English language skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Basic knowledge of robotic welding
  • Knowledge of weld monitoring systems with focus on arc characteristics and thermal cycle analysis
  • Knowledge of thermomechanical modelling of welding process
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Able to work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyse data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Keen interest in learning and working in teams

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • SFI FAST facilities, industrial network, and a joint PhD environment 
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page). The motivation letter must be aligned with the subject of this call and why the candidate finds themselves suitable for this position.
  • Possibly publications or other relevant research work (the candidate’s contribution to each work must be clarified (performed tasks and percentage of contribution)) 
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees, their relation to the applicant, and their recommendation letters for your application for this position (Note: the referees will also be directly contacted for shortlisted candidates for the position) 
  • documentation of the required criteria

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Vahid Hosseini, e-mail: vahid.hosseini@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 10.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

We educate graduates who can create new products, operate and maintain products, and manage projects. The Department has a variety of bachelor’s and master’s degree programmes. We conduct wide-ranging research in fields such as technology, energy, product quality and development, and productivity. jobs.title: Development Engineer – BONESUPPORT
jobs.description: Development Engineer – BONESUPPORTCome and join BONESUPPORT as Development Engineer! This is an opportunity to take an active role in the design and development of innovative medical devices, from early concepts to finalized products and manufacturing.BONESUPPORT is an innovative and growing medical device company based in Lund, Sweden. The company develops and commercializes injectable bio-ceramic bone graft substitutes for the treatment of bone disorders.To further strengthen our Development & Engineering department, we are now looking for a Development Engineer with a strong technical background and hands-on experience in mechanical design, product development and verification.Your roleAs Development Engineer, you will be involved in the development of new medical devices as well as improvements to existing products.You will work throughout the product development process, from concept development and mechanical design to verification, validation and transfer to manufacturing.The role has a strong technical focus, combining hands-on mechanical engineering and CAD design with testing, material selection and manufacturing considerations. You will be responsible for developing robust technical solutions that meet functional requirements and can be efficiently manufactured.You will work closely with colleagues within R&D, Operations, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs, as well as external suppliers and manufacturing partners.Your main responsibilities will include:    Design and develop medical device components and assemblies using 3D CAD tools.    Execute design activities through all product development phases.    Create and maintain engineering drawings, technical specifications and design documentation.    Perform mechanical design activities, including material selection, tolerance analysis and component optimization.    Develop technical solutions with consideration for Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA) and Design for Reliability.    Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on tooling, injection molding and manufacturing optimization.    Develop, plan and perform verification and validation testing.    Establish test methods and prepare test protocols and reports.    Analyze test results, identify potential improvements and provide recommendations for design modifications.    Participate in design reviews, risk management activities and cross-functional development projects.    Support design transfer activities and contribute to design control documentation in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.QualificationsWe are looking for a technically skilled engineer with practical experience in mechanical design and product development  within the medical device industry.To succeed in this role, we believe you have:    A technical academic background at Bachelor's level or higher, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.    Relevant experience in mechanical design and product development within the medical device industry.    Hands-on experience with 3D CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor or similar.    Experience in creating engineering drawings, technical specifications and detailed design documentation.    Good understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and mechanical design principles.    Experience in planning, performing and documenting design verification activities, including test methods, protocols and reports for mechanical and functional testing.    Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA) and tolerance analysis.    Ability to analyze technical problems, evaluate test results and develop practical engineering solutions.    Good technical writing and documentation skills.Preferred qualificationsIt is an advantage if you also have experience or knowledge in:    Injection molding, tooling and component manufacturing.    Design Control and requirements management.    Risk management according to ISO 14971.    Usability engineering according to IEC 62366.    Medical device safety standards.    Implantable medical devices.    Statistical methods and test method development.    Design transfer and collaboration with external manufacturing partners.Personal qualitiesWe believe you are analytical, structured and solution-oriented, with a strong interest in technical problem-solving and product development.You enjoy working hands-on with engineering challenges and have the ability to translate technical requirements into practical and reliable design solutions.You take ownership of your tasks, work independently and proactively drive activities forward. At the same time, you value collaboration and enjoy working with colleagues from different technical and functional backgrounds.You are comfortable working in an environment where technical challenges require both attention to detail and an understanding of the complete product development process.Why BONESUPPORT?At BONESUPPORT, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative medical devices that make a difference for patients.You will join a growing company where product development, engineering and manufacturing expertise come together. The position offers an opportunity to take an active role in technical development projects and contribute to the continued development of BONESUPPORT's products.Location: Lund, SwedenApplicationSKÅNESTOR is managing the recruitment process on behalf of BONESUPPORT.Please apply directly through this advertisement. For questions, please contact SKÅNESTOR at maria.gren@skanestor.se.

jobs.title: Lemvig Kommune søger en Dagplejer i Ramme/Lomborg området
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at arbejde professionelt med børn og ønsker en selvstændig hverdag, hvor du planlægger dagen ud fra børnenes behov? Så er Lemvig Kommunes dagpleje måske det helt rigtige sted for dig!

Om stillingen

Som dagplejer arbejder du hjemme i trygge rammer, hvor kram og smil er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får muligheden for at gøre en forskel i de vigtigste år af børnenes liv. Her kan du skabe et inspirerende miljø, hvor læring og trivsel er i fokus.

Dine opgaver

  • Skabe tryghed og gode relationer til børn og forældre.
  • Planlægge din dag ud fra børnegruppens behov.
  • Arbejde pædagogisk med fokus på børnenes trivsel, læring og udvikling.
  • Deltage i legestue og arrangementer til glæde for børnene.
  • Samarbejde med tværfaglige partnere som talepædagoger og sundhedsplejen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • Udstyr til børnene til din rådighed.
  • Tæt samarbejde med dagplejepædagoger, dagplejeledere og sekretariat.
  • Indflydelse på din egen hverdag.
  • Kollegial sparring og mentorordning.
  • Legestuegruppe med kolleger fra lokalområdet.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har god intuition og kan skabe tryghed og gode relationer gennem omsorg og nærvær.
  • Brænder for pædagogisk arbejde med børn.
  • Indgå i et godt samarbejde med forældre, kolleger og dagplejepædagoger for at skabe den bedste hverdag for børnene.
  • Vil stille dit hjem til rådighed som et inspirerende læringsmiljø.
  • Deltager aktivt i dagplejens arrangementer og møder.

Du vil få støtte til at omsætte dagplejens læreplan, så du kan skabe de bedste rammer for børnenes udvikling. I det kommende år fokuserer vi på børneperspektiv, dannelse og fællesskaber.

Løn og ansættelse

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 

Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Startlønnen for en fuldtidsansat udgør 28.406 kr. pr. måned + pension. Herudover forhandles funktions- og kvalifikationsløn på baggrund af forhåndsaftalen, dine erfaringer og personlige kvalifikationer. Arbejdsugen er 48 timer med optjening af afspadsering som kompensation.

Ansøgning

Hvis du ønsker at vide mere, kan du kontakte dagplejeleder Kristian Suusgaard på tlf. 96631830.

Da vi løbende afholder samtaler opfordrer vi til, at du sender din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Når stillingen er besat vil stillingsopslaget blive lukket. 

 

Ansøgning

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes elektronisk via Lemvig Kommunes hjemmeside senest 25-11-2026 08:10.

Læs mere om Lemvig Kommune på lemvig.dk.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

  • Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

  • Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

  • Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

  • Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

  • Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

  • Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

  • Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

  • Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

  • Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Zhanyun WangDIAS ProfessorDepartment of Green TechnologySDU Life Cycle EngineeringUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail:  zwa@igt.sdu.dk 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 12, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is in January 2026. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Gruppen arbetar även med kvalitetsgranskning och stöttar andra funktioner inom Tullverket med exempelvis fördjupade solvensbedömningar av företag. Mycket samverkan sker med enhetens andra grupp, som främst arbetar med betalningshantering och oreglerade fodringar, handläggning och övervakning av tillstånd för företag. Inom enheten deltar medarbetare även i utvecklingsarbete för att kontinuerligt förbättra och utveckla våra tjänster.Som gruppchef ansvar du för att nå uppsatta mål och förväntat resultat i enlighet med beslutade processer och strategiska inriktningar. Tillsammans med enhetschefen och gruppchefen för den andra gruppen bildar ni ett team som styr och utvecklar uppbördsenhet nord. jobs.title: Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Practical information and how to apply

Salary and start date by agreement.

Send a short application and your CV to job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Tell us why you’d like to work with us, whether you’re looking for approximately 60 or up to 120 hours per month, and when you can start.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Line operator for production in Horsens
jobs.description:
The job

We are looking for a reliable and experienced employee to join a production and slaughterhouse facility located in Horsens.

The position involves supervising and monitoring the slaughter and production line, ensuring that production runs efficiently and that quality standards are maintained throughout the process.

You will be involved in several stages of production, from the arrival of live stock to the point where the end product enters the cooling system.

Main Responsibilities

  • Receive and register deliveries of live animals.

  • Handle and verify documentation relating to weight, quantity and delivery information.

  • Communicate with veterinary inspectors upon arrival of live animals.

  • Monitor the slaughter line and ensure smooth daily operations.

  • Supervise the stunning equipment and make necessary adjustments.

  • Monitor and adjust scalding tanks and plucking machines to maintain optimal processing quality.

  • Record machine settings, adjustments and relevant production information.

  • Monitor the packing process and quality of the meat.

  • Identify and report production or quality issues.

  • Ensure compliance with hygiene, food safety and animal welfare procedures.

Your Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Preferably has experience in poultry processing, slaughterhouse operations or food production.

  • Has technical understanding and is comfortable monitoring and adjusting production equipment.

  • Is quality-conscious, responsible and able to work independently.

  • Is comfortable working in a slaughterhouse environment and handling live animals.

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and overtime.

  • Can communicate effectively with colleagues and relevant personnel.

Working hours and conditions

  • Primarily a 4-day working week (Monday – Thursday)

  • Every 7th and 8th week, the schedule includes 5 working days (Monday – Friday)

  • Start time 06:30 AM. Working hours depend on production and continue until the slaughter line has finished operating. Long working days and overtime must be expected. Some shifts may continue until approximately 18:00 or later.

Salary and benefits

  • Salary based on qualifications and relevant experience.

  • Pension according to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

  • Additional flexible benefits (fritvalg) according to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

  • Employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Interested?

Are you experienced in slaughterhouse production or production in general and looking for a new opportunity in Horsens?

We would like to hear from you.

Apply today by uploading your CV and a short description of your relevant experience.

jobs.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Ferb is a Danish startup building booking and payment software for fitness, yoga, wellness and sauna studios. We’re growing fast and are looking for a Sales and Marketing Specialist to help more studios find and choose Ferb.

What you’ll do

  • Sales: find and contact fitness, yoga, wellness and sauna studios, including studios that use other booking systems; hold meetings and demonstrations of our booking software; and follow up until new studios sign.

  • Marketing: plan and carry out our marketing towards studios, including campaigns, newsletters, social media, content, events and customer stories.

  • Customer relationships: hand new studios over to onboarding, and stay in contact with existing studios to support renewals, upgrades and referrals.

  • Market insight: collect feedback from studios and the market about needs, competitors and prices, and share it with the founders.

Who you are

  • You’re structured, curious and comfortable talking to new people.

  • You communicate clearly in English, in writing and in person.

  • You’re comfortable with digital tools and like working in a small, fast-moving team.

  • Experience with sales, marketing or software is a plus, but not required.

What we offer

  • A full-time position (37 hours a week) at our office in Frederiksberg, starting 1 January 2027. All hours in the office.

  • Salary according to qualifications.

  • Close collaboration with the founders and a real influence on how Ferb grows.

How to applyApplications end by 13 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Power Platform Advisor - AI & Solution Architecture
jobs.description: **We are looking for an experienced professional who wants to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, useful solutions—and help customers make the right choices along the way. This role brings together business insight, solution architecture and hands-on development. You will help customers discover what is worth building, shape the solution, and stay involved in making it real.****About the role**You will work closely with customers to understand their challenges, processes and constraints—and uncover the real need behind the initial request. You will turn those discussions into viable opportunities, sound architectural choices and an actionable delivery plan. Depending on the assignment, you may take the work from discovery and solution shaping through implementation, deployment and further development.This is not a role for a purely high-level architect. We are looking for someone who can design the bigger picture, document the decisions that matter, and still build or validate key parts of the solution.Our home ground is Microsoft Power Platform and the broader Microsoft cloud ecosystem. Depending on the assignment, your toolkit may include Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, API Management, Microsoft Fabric, GitHub and GitHub Copilot.**What you could be working on**The exact mix will depend on the customer and assignment, but your work could include:- Leading stakeholder discussions to uncover the real business need and decide what is worth building. - Turning requirements into scalable solution architectures, data models, integration designs and practical delivery plans. - Designing and delivering intelligent applications, agents and automation with Power Platform, Azure and related services. - Creating clear architecture diagrams, technical notes and decision records that make assumptions, constraints and trade-offs visible. - Building and validating key parts of the solution yourself, while giving concrete technical guidance to the wider delivery team. - Helping customers make informed choices about feasibility, security, maintainability, lifecycle and good engineering practices. **Your background could look like this**You might currently describe yourself as a solution architect, application architect, technical consultant or senior developer. Perhaps you are a Power Platform professional who has worked with complex integrations, Azure services, and enterprise application architecture. Or you may come from pro-code software development and have moved towards architecture and consulting. There is more than one route into this role.What matters most is your ability to combine three perspectives:1\. **Technology:** You understand how modern applications are designed and built. You can discuss architecture, integrations, APIs, data, identity and security, and you are comfortable going into technical detail.2\. **Business:** You can uncover the actual need behind a request, ask the right questions, and help the customer decide what is worth building.3\. **Delivery:** You can turn plans, experiments and architectural choices into working, maintainable solutions.You do not need to arrive knowing every technology. However, you do need enough technical depth to make informed decisions independently, recognize risks and learn unfamiliar technologies without waiting for a predefined path.Above all, we value curiosity, sound judgement and a continuous learning mindset.**What we are looking for:**Titles matter less than what you can do. We are looking for someone who:- Enjoys solving business problems with technology - Can design the bigger picture without losing touch with implementation - Is excited about AI and modern Microsoft technologies & has experience working with both areas - Feels comfortable discussing architecture with developers and business stakeholders alike - Has experience delivering customer-facing projects and building trusted relationships - Wants to keep learning and sharing knowledge with others - Has fluent communication and presentation skills in Finnish and English Above all, we highly appreciate applicants with a continuous learning mindset.You will be part of our experienced Power Platform masterminds. On average, your colleagues have 5–20 years of relevant experience each, so you'll get to be part of an experienced group of experts.\*\*\***What to expect from the recruitment process**- Application period 27.10.–29.11.2026 - First meeting with Päivikki, team lead, and Poola, People & Culture - Second, more technical meeting with potential future colleagues - Preferred starting date according to agreement, in the beginning of 2027 Any changes to the process will be communicated to the applicants.**What we offer**- A central role where you can make an impact! - A great work home for professionals – our eNPS is 82! - A caring employer where we focus on impact and thriving together – who also supports continuous learning - Supportive, balanced and collaborative work environment & a culture which is built on trust - Flexible working hours and location (unlimited remote work according to company policy); https://careers.forwardforever.com/posts/remote-hybrid-or-office-honestly-we-don-t-label-it - Comprehensive company benefits including an additional health insurance Expected compensation will be within the range of 5000-6500 €/month.We are looking forward to hearing from you! Please send your resume and application letter at the latest on 29.11.2026 through our job ad. We will not just wait for the application period to hit its deadline, and neither should you! We will go through the applications already during the application period and fill the position as soon as we find the right person.If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to reach out to Poola, poola.isomaki@forwardforever.com. Please note that we use emails as part of our communication so double check that you have added an email address that you follow regularly.**Let's change the game, together!**

jobs.title: Backend Developer / Engineer - 20450
jobs.description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced Backend Developer / Engineer for a consulting assignment within a team responsible for release management of the organization’s primary applications. The mission is to enhance and streamline the release process through improved monitoring, automation, and quality assurance.The organization is transitioning from Jira to a new tool and needs to establish a separate database for release tracking. The consultant will analyze dependencies and automation flows between Jira projects and release tools, then design and implement an appropriate technical solution. A central part of the assignment is the continued development of an existing dashboard into a unified decision-support solution. It will provide clear performance and stability metrics, defined thresholds, and quality gates with approved, warning, and blocked status levels.The solution must guide release managers toward clear next steps and automatically create issues and send notifications when deviations occur, without negatively affecting release cadence. Initial support will cover the organization’s most important Android and iOS applications, with the possibility of future expansion.Key Responsibilities    Analyze dependencies, integrations, and automation flows between Jira projects and release management tools.    Design and implement a separate database and supporting technical solution for release tracking.    Enhance an existing dashboard into a consolidated decision-support tool for release stakeholders.    Implement metrics for application performance and stability, including thresholds and quality gates.    Provide actionable guidance for release managers based on approved, warning, and blocked status levels.    Automate issue creation and notifications when release metrics or quality indicators deviate from defined thresholds.    Develop end-to-end functionality across backend and frontend components.    Collaborate closely with release managers, data scientists, and release engineers to translate operational needs into usable technical solutions.    Ensure that delivered code is tested, maintainable, and thoroughly documented for ongoing support and development.    Work independently within large, established codebases and deliver useful results from the beginning of the assignment.Technical Stack & Requirements    Backend: Strong development expertise in Java and Python.    APIs and services: Experience designing services and developing REST or gRPC APIs.    Frontend: Practical experience with React and TypeScript.    Data-intensive interfaces: Experience building user-friendly internal tools and dashboards that process or present large data volumes.    Release tooling: Experience analyzing and automating workflows involving Jira and release management platforms.    Mobile delivery: Knowledge of release processes for Android and iOS applications is advantageous.    CI/CD: Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery tools is preferred.    Backstage: Previous experience developing Backstage plugins is advantageous.Qualifications & ExperienceA minimum of five years of software development experience is required, together with documented success delivering full-stack functionality from initial design through production-ready implementation. The consultant must be comfortable entering large, existing codebases, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and working independently with limited guidance. Strong product understanding is required, including the ability to translate ambiguous processes and stakeholder needs into simple, practical tools. The role also requires effective written and verbal communication and experience collaborating across multiple teams.

jobs.title: SiS ungdomshem Stigby söker familjebehandlare
jobs.description: Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring. SiS ungdomshem Stigby på Visingsö har plats för 35 ungdomar och tar emot icke skolpliktiga pojkar med psykosocial problematik, kriminalitet och missbruk. Vi är uppdelad på en MBB-avdelning (mottagning- och behovsbedömning), fyra behandlingsavdelningar och en utskrivningsförberedande avdelning i Jönköping. ArbetsbeskrivningSiS ungdomshem Stigby söker familjebehandlare som vill vara med och skapa den livsviktiga skillnaden för utsatta människor.I rollen som familjebehandlare har du en viktig roll i våra placerade ungdomars behandling. Familjebehandlaren ansvarar för att arbeta mot ungdomarnas familjer, släktnätverk och nätverk med målsättningen att skapa delaktighet, förutsättningar till förändring och samarbete som bidrar till positiva behandlingsresultat.Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och innebär bland annat att skapa ett stabilt samarbete med föräldrar, familj och övrigt aktörer som t.ex. socialtjänst. Familjeterapeutiska samtal, individuella föräldrasamtal, psykoedukativa insatser, föräldrastödsprogram (SiS använder Komet). Det ingår även att förbereda besök av föräldrar på ungdomshemmet samt att planera och följa upp ungdomarnas vistelser hemma. Målsättningen är att stödja en positiv kommunikation och relation mellan ungdom, familj, föräldrar och att mobilisera stöd i deras nätverk samt att stärka föräldrarnas färdigheter och förmågor. I uppdraget ingår även tät kontakt med både ungdomar och behandlingspersonal på avdelning. Som familjebehandlare behöver du vara flexibel, självgående och ha god samarbetsförmåga. Du kommer till stor del planera din arbetsdag själv genom digital kommunikation, besök och hemmavistelser utifrån ungdomarnas behov samtidigt som arbetet runt varje enskild ungdom bedrivs i teamsamverkan med psykolog, behandlingssekreterare, avdelningspersonal, sjuksköterska och lärare.  Läs mer om familjebehandlarnas arbete som skapar trygghet och gemenskap - https://siw.stat-inst.se/stod-och-service/aktuellt/arkiv/2025/november/familjebehandlarnas-vardag-skapar-tillit-och-forandringArbetstiden är förlagd till dagtid. Vid behov förväntas du vara flexibel och anpassningsbar för att tillsammans med verksamheten hitta lösningar som möjliggör att insatser kan genomföras. Resor i tjänsten förekommer.Kvalifikationer Som familjebehandlare behöver du ha en förmåga att inge förtroende och hopp till familjerna. Vara modig och våga prata om det som är svårt och samtidigt hitta de positiva styrkorna som finns inom familjen. Du ska kunna skilja på det personliga och privata för att skapa tillit till familjebehandlaren, ungdomshemmet och SiS. Lyssna, kommunicera och hantera motsättningar på ett konstruktivt sätt. Ha förmågan att förbli motiverad och effektiv trots bakslag och besvikelser. Kunna arbeta tills projekt är avslutade eller resultaten är uppnådda. Det är viktigt att du som familjebehandlare har förmåga att skapa goda samarbeten och ser teamarbetet som det mest grundläggande för vården. Det är meriterande att ha arbetat med ungdomar och deras familj/nätverk tidigare. Krav:    Högskoleexamen som socionom eller annan beteendevetenskaplig inriktning alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig    Erfarenhet av att möta unga människor i en utsatt livssituation    Körkort B Meriterande:    Steg 1 psykoterapi eller motsvarande erfarenhet av familjearbete under handledning     Erfarenhet av behandling i låsbar miljö AnställningTjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Kokemäelle
jobs.description: **Haemme ammattisiivoojaa avustamaan asiakastamme Kokemäellä.****Mitä siivooja-helpperi tekee?** Siivooja-helpperi on henkilö, joka tukee asiakkaitamme ammatillisessa kotisiivouksessa. Asiakkaamme saa aina oman helpperinsä avukseen. Työ on mielekästä, sillä helpperinä pääset myös tutustumaan asiakkaaseen.Hemby tarjoaa kotisiivouksia tekeville helppereillemme laadukkaat siivousvälineet mikrokuituliinoista pesuaineisiin. Kotisiivouskäynneillä hyödynnämme asiakkaan imuria ja moppia lattioiden siistimiseen.**Mitä työ vaatii?** Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta. Lisäksi asiakaspalveluhenkisyys sekä reipas ote ovat työssä tarvittavia ominasuuksia. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat. Edellytämme työntekijöiltämme 18-vuoden ikää.**Mikä on Hemby?**Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme.**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:_"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."__"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."__Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan._**Siivooja-helpperinä saat:**- **Omat nimetyt asiakkaat**, joita autat kotisiivouksessa. - **Joustavat työajat,** jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa 2-6 tunnin ajan, riippuen asiakkaan asunnon koosta. - **Kilpailukykyisen palkan:** Tuntipalkka 13,20-15,98 €/h + yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. - **Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet:** Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän työpanoksesi ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! - **Monipuolisen työn:** siivoojana voit halutessasi myös olla avuksi asiakkaillemme arjen muissa askareissa. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä:**https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksi**Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen. Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää siivooja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: IAM Software Engineer
Pattern Design Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pattern design and motivated by bringing out the best in others? Do you enjoy taking the lead, driving projects forward and finding better ways of working, without losing touch with the craft you love?

Whether you're an experienced manager or looking to take your first step into leadership, at SELECTED you'll have the opportunity to lead a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants across menswear and womenswear while staying hands-on with pattern development.

YOUR TEAMYou'll become part of SELECTED's creative environment, where pattern design plays an important role in bringing our collections to life.Working closely with colleagues in Design and Buying, you and your team will turn design ideas into well-constructed garments, finding the right balance between creative intentions, fit, quality and commercial considerations.With responsibilities spanning both menswear and womenswear, you'll work with different perspectives and priorities, helping create a shared approach and strong collaboration across the two areas.

YOUR ROLEYou'll take responsibility for the team's performance and development while continuing to work hands-on with pattern development within your own product category.Beyond the day-to-day leadership, you'll drive projects, bring structure to shared priorities and help develop the technical standards and processes behind our collections. Your experience will be important in guiding decisions, solving technical challenges and ensuring progress across menswear and womenswear.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and developing a team of pattern designers and fitting assistants, supporting their individual growth and performance.

  • Taking hands-on responsibility for pattern development within your own product category, including fittings and technical adjustments.

  • Driving projects and coordinating priorities across menswear and womenswear.

  • Developing pattern design processes and technical standards to improve fit, construction and consistency.

  • Working closely with Design and Buying to find solutions that meet both creative and commercial needs.

  • Exploring and implementing digital pattern-making and 3D development tools where they can improve our work.

YOUR BENEFITSAt SELECTED, you'll be part of an international fashion business with high ambitions and a genuine interest in doing things better. We work across disciplines, challenge each other's thinking and believe that good ideas can come from anywhere. It's an environment where you're encouraged to contribute your perspective and make your experience count.We also recognise that doing great work doesn't mean working the same way every day. You'll have flexibility in planning your work and the opportunity to work from home when your responsibilities allow it, balancing time with your colleagues and the freedom to organise your own day.

YOUR PROFILEYou know your craft and enjoy using your experience to make others better. You're comfortable taking responsibility, bringing structure to projects and making decisions, even when different perspectives and priorities need to be considered.For us, your ability and motivation to lead matter more than whether you've held a management title before. You might already have experience managing a team, or you might be an experienced specialist ready to take on your first formal leadership role. What matters is that you can provide clear direction, involve others and create an environment where people can develop and deliver strong results together.

We imagine that you bring:

  • Solid experience in pattern design and garment construction within the fashion industry, including a strong understanding of fit, silhouettes and technical garment development.

  • The ability to plan, coordinate and drive projects involving different stakeholders.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to navigate different perspectives and priorities.

  • A structured approach to your work and an interest in improving existing methods.

  • An interest in digital pattern-making and 3D garment development.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Manja Ann Jacobsen on + 45 52 15 37 30. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 26 November 2026.  We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad, when we find the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

jobs.title: Tekninen myyjä (AI)

Tärkeintä on kyky ymmärtää asiakkaan tarpeita ja löytää niihin sopivat ratkaisut.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- **Provisiopohjaisen palkkauksen:** Ansiot määräytyvät myyntitulostesi mukaan - **Mahdollisuuden hyviin ansioihin:** Aktiivisella ja tuloksellisella myyntityöllä voit päästä erittäin hyviin ansioihin - Joustavan yhteistyömallin, joka sopii myös Tmi-yrittäjälle - Tuote-esittelyt, myyntimateriaalit ja teknisen asiantuntijatuen - Vapauden organisoida omaa myyntityötäsi - Mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen yhteistyöhön ja kehittymiseen kasvavalla tekoälyalalla **Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- Myyntihenkistä, tavoitteellista ja oma-aloitteista asennetta - Kiinnostusta teknologiaan, ohjelmistoihin ja tekoälyyn - Kykyä lähestyä yritysasiakkaita ja keskustella päättäjien kanssa - Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja - **_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._ **_Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi_**

jobs.title: Bli personlig assistent i Nacka kommun – ett meningsfullt arbete året runt

Du är trygg i dig själv, lyhörd för andra människors behov och har ett respektfullt bemötande i alla situationer.Eftersom arbetet ofta innebär att arbeta självständigt behöver du ha god personlig mognad och kunna fatta välgrundade beslut i vardagen. Du är flexibel och lösningsorienterad, ser möjligheter i förändrade situationer och har lätt för att anpassa dig efter varje kunds unika behov.Framför allt har du ett genuint engagemang för att stödja andra människor och bidra till ökad livskvalitet, självständighet och trygghet.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.Om ossOmsorg & assistansverksamheten är en kommunal verksamhet som arbetar på uppdrag av Socialtjänsten och Försäkringskassan i Nacka. Vi erbjuder stöd och service till vuxna, barn och ungdomar med funktionsnedsättning enligt LSS och SoL.Vi erbjuderHos oss får du ett flexibelt och utvecklande arbete där du varje dag bidrar till att göra skillnad för andra. Du blir en del av en verksamhet som präglas av engagemang, delaktighet och respekt för varje människas behov och förutsättningar.Vi erbjuder en trygg introduktion och goda möjligheter att arbeta som timvikarie året runt. Blanketten "För arbete i hemmet med äldre och funktionshindrade hittar du här. jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive, UK
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Description

Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s UK growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular UK travel, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our UK Commercial team.

We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week.

What You’ll Do

Grow Horizon3.ai’s UK Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions.

  • Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the UK market.

  • Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities.

  • Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention.

  • Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood.

  • Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas.

  • Previous experience selling technical solutions into the UK market.

  • Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential.

  • Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management.

  • The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person.

  • Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack.

  • The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

  • Fluency in English; additional language skills are welcomed.

Travel Required

We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

jobs.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines.

Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht.

Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten;

  • Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties;

  • Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen;

  • Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties;

  • Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd;

  • Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service.

Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen.


Wij vragen

  • HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.
