jobs.title: Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development (combined position)
jobs.description:
Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development 

A combined position as Professor (50%) and as Research Director (50%) is vacant at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and at the Centre for Shared Decision Making, Lillebaelt Hospital, Vejle, respectively.

The position is offered for five years, with the possibility of extension.

The academic positionThe professor will advance research into shared decision-making (SDM) and the involvement of patients and their relatives, as well as the professional development required to integrate these approaches into clinical practice. The professor will be part of the management team at the joint centre at Lillebælt Hospital and will foster coherence between research, education and implementation. The professor will be appointed at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU. The academic field combines SDM with professional development for healthcare professionals. Interdisciplinary research and collaboration across clinical settings are expected and central to the position.

Research leadership and responsibilitiesAt Lillebaelt Hospital, the professor/appointee will serve as Research Director. Together with the Centre Director, the Research Director forms the joint center leadership. The Research Director has line management responsibility for academic staff and overall scientific and strategic responsibility for research activities associated with the Center for Shared Decision Making (CFFB) and the Center for Involvement of Relatives (CEPI). The two leadership roles work closely together on the development of the centers.

The professor is expected responsible for:

  • Strategic Research Leadership and Centre ManagementThe position as professor includes overall scientific and strategic responsibility for the research units affiliated with both CFFB and CEPI as well as their interdisciplinary research group. This includes line management and academic leadership of researchers, ensuring the stable operation of the centers, and maintaining strategic oversight of the centers’ grant portfolio and funding pipeline.

  • Fundraising and External Research FundingThe professor is expected to secure substantial external research funding from national and international funding bodies to ensure the long-term sustainability and development of the centers’ research activities.

  • Practice-Oriented Empirical ResearchThe professor is expected to develop and lead empirical research SDM projects with a particular focus on the perspectives of patients, relatives, and healthcare professionals within different diseases, specialties and healthcare settings, while contributing to the advancement of qualitative and applied research methodologies such as action research.

  • Development of Educational Resources, Curriculum Design, and Educational TransformationThe position requires designing and developing practical educational tools and implementation resources — e.g., learning materials — that support healthcare professionals’ learning and continuing professional development in clinical practice performing SDM.

  • Teaching, lecturing, supervising and disseminating knowledgeThe professor should teach and mentor postdocs, PhD students, and undergraduate students. Participation in assessment work is part of the position. Additionally, profiling this research area in the public eye will be an important task.

Research activity, network and collaborationThe candidate is expected to demonstrate prior experience with research activities in terms of networks and collaborations. The professor is expected to increase research activity at the research unit and to expand collaboration with other researchers at hospitals in the Region of Southern Denmark, at SDU, the rest of Denmark and internationally.

The position as Research Director at the Centre for Shared Decision Making (CFFB)The Professorship in Shared Decision-making and Professional Development at the Center for Shared Decision Making, Vejle, Denmark, is established to support the continued implementation of Lillebaelt Hospital’s research strategy and the hospital’s overarching commitment to placing the patient at the center of care.

Over the past decade, the Center has conducted research on evidence-based approaches to SDM and has demonstrated that SDM is associated with high patient satisfaction and improved adherence to agreed treatment plans. The professorship will build on this strong research foundation by advancing knowledge on the implementation of SDM and the continuing professional development of healthcare professionals. International research consistently shows that achieving sustained and authentic SDM practice in everyday clinical care remains a significant implementation challenge. Changing professional practices and departmental cultures requires more than time-limited projects or implementation initiatives. Sustainable integration of SDM depends on ongoing and continuous competence development that supports long-term changes in clinical practice.

This professorship is positioned at the intersection of health sciences research, implementation in clinical practice, and professional development through applied educational research. The core purpose of the position is to strengthen and transform the healthcare system’s capacity for meaningful patient and family involvement through SDM.

The professorship requires strategic research leadership from a scholar with extensive expertise in lifelong learning, learning theory, curriculum theory, and action research, and with the ability to translate this knowledge into continuing professional development for healthcare professionals. The professor is expected to lead the national and international research agenda on how SDM can be integrated meaningfully and sustainably into routine clinical practice, to achieve enduring behavioral change among healthcare professionals.

QualificationsThe required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent post-graduate research qualification and demonstrate scientific achievements at a level appropriate for appointment as Professor.

  • The position calls for expertise in educational science as applied to the professional development of healthcare staff or other types of welfare staff, together with substantial knowledge of and research contributions to SDM.

  • The applicant should be able to demonstrate experience of teaching and lecturing at university and postgraduate level, as well as experience as principal supervisor on PhD projects and academic assessment work, as evidenced by the teaching portfolio.

  • Danish language skills are not required at the time of appointment, but must be mastered at proficiency level C1, at the Common European Framework of References for Languages within the first 2 years of employment.

The ideal candidate preferably demonstrates:

  • The candidate should demonstrate experience with leadership capacity with the ability to lead research teams, drive cultural change, and contribute strategically to the development of the centers.

  • The candidate holds experience in research management, interdisciplinary collaboration, and attraction of external funding for professional development and/or SDM-oriented activities will be considered an advantage.

  • The candidate preferably demonstrates experience with practice-oriented empirical research. Research that is aimed at both an international research community, and ideally also at the target group of professionals in Denmark; therefore, publications and outputs are welcome to be in Danish – whether in the form of books, leaflets, journal publications or other material designed to ensure that both professionals undertaking continuing professional development in Denmark and students on undergraduate program are best supported and thereby ensuring impact.

  • The candidate has prior experience with developing, implementing, and/or evaluating educational programs, frameworks, and curricula for continuing professional development, preferably in terms of SDM-related competencies. Experience of developing and evaluating continuing professional education in clinical settings is valued.

  • The preferred candidate can motivate and supervise, has proven research management skills, good interpersonal skills in charge of a research group, and has a clear vision for how to further strengthen the research unit at CFFB as strong interpersonal and collaborative skills are essential.

  • The successful applicant will have documented experience of leading research and researchers, obtain external funding and work across disciplines and organizations.

EmployersCFFB is a national knowledge and competence center based at Lillebaelt Hospital. Since 2014, it has researched SDM and since 2019 developed approaches for implementation in clinical practice. CEPI works to strengthen meaningful involvement of relatives. The centers retain their distinct areas of responsibility while collaborating closely on research and practice. Lillebaelt Hospital provides somatic and mental healthcare across sites in Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart. Patient and family involvement is central to their approach to care.

SDU's Department of Regional Health Research links research and education with hospitals and clinical environments across the Region of Southern Denmark. The Department of Regional Health Research supports research in relation to the person as a whole, the good life and the more common diseases, makes out a platform for scientists and educators and builds a bridge between University of Southern Denmark, The Region of Southern Denmark, the hospitals in the region and the patient. The department focuses on the continuity of patient care across sectors, hospitals, and specialist fields.

Reference The professor and research director will refer to the hospital management regarding matters concerning the management of the centres, and to the Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, Mikkel Brabrand, in matters regarding the professorship.

Contact informationFurther information concerning the position can be obtained by contacting:

  • The Research Coordinator at Lillebælt Hospital, Jonna Skov Madsen, Jonna.Skov.Madsen@rsyd.dk, +45 30507825

  • The Director of the Centre, Karina Olling, Karina.Olling@rsyd.dk, +45 51518696

  • The Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, SDU, Mikkel Brabrand, mbrabrand@health.sdu.dk, +45 93534980

Salary and terms of employmentThe successful applicant for the professor position will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Professor is salaried in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and on terms corresponding to salary grade 37 of the Danish state salary system. Additional qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Center for Shared Decision Making (Center for Fælles Beslutningstagning), Beriderbakken 4, 7100 Vejle, Denmark.

ApplicationOnly applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • An application

  • A detailed CV

  • Degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma or equivalent)

  • A complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position (please notice that one pdf file must be attached for each publication)

  • It is permitted to merge the 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications into a single PDF file due to upload constraints.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • Track record in obtaining research funding

  • National and international research collaboration and collaborations with researchers in other disciplines and sectors

  • A research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. Incomplete applications with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

The application deadline is 11 November 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

AssessmentShortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

jobs.description: Senior Supply Chain Expert, Amazon Vendor ServicesJob ID: 10580075 | Amazon EU SarlDescriptionAmazon Vendor Services is a paid business-to-business service that helps strategic brands partner with Amazon to grow their business. As a Senior Supply Chain Expert, you independently own the complete, end-to-end supply chain for a portfolio of complex brands at a Pan-European level - from their long-term, three-year plan through to day-to-day availability, inventory health and profitability. You act as a trusted consultant, balancing service, cost and profitability across the full supply chain, and you set and own the success metrics you work on daily, ensuring every brand's experience demonstrates our customer obsession.You work at project and program level and handle difficult, ambiguous situations with limited direction. You drive alignment across multiple internal and external stakeholders - the brand, retail, operations and finance - to implement new supply chain solutions and structurally improve the ways of working around you as you develop toward the next step in your career.Key job responsibilities- Supply chain strategy & design (Strategic): Independently own and drive the long-term, three-year supply chain strategy for a portfolio of complex brands - a business solution you take from strategy through to implementation on your own initiative. You design the right mix of solutions for each brand, weighing availability, speed, cost and profitability together rather than optimising one link in isolation, align demand and network strategy with the brand's growth ambitions and Amazon's, and secure stakeholder commitment to the plan.- Implementing new supply chain solutions (High-judgment delivery): Independently lead the onboarding and roll-out of new supply chain solutions in ambiguous, non-standard situations where the path is not defined. You exercise high judgment, drive timely decisions, and align and unblock stakeholders across the brand, operations, finance and internal teams to get solutions live and adopted.- Profitability, buying & inventory health (Analysis & action): Keep the brand's supply chain healthy and profitable day to day - availability, stock positioning, lead times, cost to serve and margin. You put artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to work to accelerate your analysis, surface where profitability or service is slipping, and automate the way you work - then act on the underlying cause across the full supply chain, not just the symptom in front of you.- Performance management & communication (Impact at scale): Own the performance of your brands against their plan and be the voice of that story - writing crisp narratives and leading the business reviews that set the agenda, align senior internal and external stakeholders, and drive the decisions that close performance gaps before they surface.- Programs & team direction (Scope beyond your portfolio): Lead cross-cutting projects that extend well beyond your own brands. You identify where the biggest opportunities sit, define and deliver solutions that program teams adopt and scale across the organisation, and influence the direction and priorities of the wider team. You design the metrics we are measured by, challenge whether they capture the outcomes that matter, and set the standard - eliminating broken processes and establishing the mechanisms others build on.A day in the lifeThis role requires managing long-term strategy and day-to-day priorities at the same time, and judging which needs your attention first. In a single day you may move from a three-year strategy discussion with a brand to a time-sensitive decision on a supply disruption where the data is incomplete. The problems are rarely pre-defined, so you decide what matters most, where the opportunity is, and what to set aside. Alongside your brands, you manage projects that define the team's strategy and direction and set how we work with program teams. The variables are interdependent and the trade-offs are real, with no fixed process for the most difficult decisions. You are expected to work through that ambiguity independently and are trusted to act. Beyond the core job, you will work in a diverse, international team, have the freedom to build your own tools, learn from experienced mentors, and take up learning opportunities that grow your skills well beyond your day-to-day scope.About the teamWe are a Pan-European team of Supply Chain Experts who partner directly with strategic brands to grow their business with Amazon. jobs.description: Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops ExcellenceJob ID: 10578661 | Amazon EU SarlDescriptionAt Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job.Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement.Key job responsibilities- Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network.- Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap.- Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand.- Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact.- Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact.- Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership.- Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption.- Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time.About the teamThe Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost.Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field- Experience in program or project management, delivering initiatives from concept to execution.- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or other BI packages.- Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams, including operations.- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements.- Experience with hands-on SQL coding and working with large, complex data sets to design models and scenarios.- Experience communicating and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including presenting complex, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.Preferred Qualifications- Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field.- Experience in operations, transportation, or supply chain.- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements.- Experience rolling out tools, processes, or mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.- Experience with data warehouse architectures, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and analytic tools and environments.- Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Athena, AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, and IAM.- Python programming experience for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and basic statistical analysis.- Experience partnering with technology teams to translate business needs into system requirements and new features.Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo sarà assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte su Nord-Ovest Italia e occasionalmente Sud Francia. Leadership concreta e capacità di gestione del team, capacità di far rispettare regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Padova organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO di: EMPOWERMENT FEMMINILE, DIRITTI E PARI OPPORTUNITÀ NEL MONDO DEL LAVORO Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata complessiva di 40 ore e si focalizza su strumenti pratici e conoscenze utili per valorizzare il proprio profilo professionale, orientarsi nel mercato del lavoro e conoscere diritti, tutele e strategie per affrontare situazioni critiche o discriminatorie. Argomenti principali: - Valorizzare competenze e punti di forza in modo credibile e mirato; - Costruire CV e candidatura efficaci, anche dopo periodi di inattività; - Affrontare colloqui in presenza o online con maggiore sicurezza; - Conoscere diritti e tutele (contratti, congedi, parità retributiva); - Riconoscere e gestire situazioni discriminatorie nel luogo di lavoro; - Negoziare condizioni di lavoro con una comunicazione assertiva. Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso avrà una durata di 40 ore e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) presso Tack&TMI Padova - Via San Crispino 8, Padova. Le lezioni si terranno in orario 9:00-13:00 o 9:00-14:00, nel periodo tra il 16 novembre e il 7 dicembre. La partecipazione attiva al corso prevede la possibilità di richiedere un Bonus di Partecipazione rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego competente del territorio. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. jobs.title: ingegnere meccanico
jobs.description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Hybrid working model: Smart Working options and flexible hours to help you achieve a better work-life balance. Siin ei ole iga tööpäev ühesugune ning alati ei piisa ainult detaili väljavahetamisest. Oluline on oskus kaasa mõelda, leida töötav lahendus ja viia alustatud töö lõpuni.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

 - Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

 - Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

 - Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

 - Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

 - Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

 - Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

 - Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

 - Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

 - Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Office of the President
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to partner directly with Replit’s President, Michele Catasta. As Replit leads in making useful intelligence accessible to all, you will serve as the company President's primary operational and strategic force multiplier across these critical organizations.

Your mandate is to own the most complex cross-functional challenges, unblock technical and operational bottlenecks, and ensure that the core product, engineering, and organizational engines operate with speed, coherence, and precision.

This is a high-leverage individual contributor (IC) role, not a traditional management track or team-building post. You will scale your personal leverage through AI workflows, agentic automation, and rigorous analytical judgment, influence, not headcount. You are the operator Michele turns to when an issue spans multiple disciplines such as technical architecture, product execution, support feedback loops, or organizational design and demands a single, decisive owner.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Act as Trusted Advisor & Operational Stand-in: Serve as a direct thought partner and proxy for Michele. Elevate core operational insights, synthesize briefings for high-stakes technical and organizational decisions, and step in as a representative when needed.

 - Proactively Clear Cross-Functional Friction: Anticipate blind spots and resolve organizational bottlenecks before they escalate. Bridge natural seams between Engineering, Product, Support, AI teams to ensure high-cadence execution.

 - Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for Complex Initiatives: Spearhead high-priority projects that lack a neat functional home such as evolving product unit economics, developer tooling infrastructure shifts, pricing models, or technical re-architectures.

 - Scale Impact via AI & Automation: Actively build and deploy AI agents, automation pipelines, and modern operational workflows to multiply your personal bandwidth across status synthesis, metrics tracking, scenario modeling, and operational monitoring.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not a Routine Data / BI Role: You will not be building routine dashboards, running routine SQL queries, or handling standard quarterly analytics. Those belong to Data, RevOps, and Strategic Finance.

 - Not Bureaucracy or Process for Process’s Sake: We prioritize momentum, rapid iteration, and decisiveness over heavy governance frameworks or dense slide decks.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 7+ Years in High-Growth Tech: Proven track record in strategy, operations, product operations, or technical chief of staff roles, with extensive time spent working shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product leadership.

 - Cross-Domain Credibility: Strong technical fluency to earn the respect of Staff/Principal Engineers and AI researchers, paired with the operational empathy to partner effectively with Support and People teams.

 - Exceptional Execution in Ambiguity: The ability to take ill-defined, sprawling problems, define clean problem boundaries, and drive them to resolution without formal line authority.

 - Strong Quantitative & Analytical Toolkit: Deep comfort evaluating unit economics, interrogating technical systems data, building scenario models, and separating actionable signal from noise.

 - Executive-Ready Communication: Direct, concise communicator who can deliver unambiguous trade-offs and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and brevity.

 - Hands-on AI & Agent Automation: Active, practical experience leveraging LLM workflows, coding agents, and automation frameworks to amplify daily productivity and analytical depth.

 - Presence & Proximity: Continual availability is essential. Ability to work in-person (at least) three days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) in Foster City, CA, collaborating closely on-site with leadership.

 - Scale Experience: Experience navigating rapid organizational scaling while maintaining high cultural and engineering standards.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Deep Developer Tooling Background: Prior experience in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, AI coding assistants, or developer-focused software ecosystems.


HOW WE’LL KNOW IT’S WORKING

 - Decision Velocity Across Functions Increases: Product, engineering, and support initiatives move from scoping to execution faster, with clear alignment and measurable business impact.

 - Net-Negative Friction: Teams actively seek your partnership because your involvement removes ambiguity, sharpens priorities, and unblocks progress rather than introducing overhead.

 - Integrated Health Sightlines: Replit's President has continuous, high-signal visibility into the operating health, technical execution, and organizational sentiment across all reporting groups.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description: Priority deadline: October 27. Complete the short form at https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn, then email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the subject line "EA application, FULL NAME." STILLART · FULL TIME · SOUTHERN FINLAND, WITH WEEKLY TIME IN PERSONFor two decades, StillArt has helped orchestras and arts organizations fill their halls. The company works. What it needs now is someone to protect the mind behind it.A COMPANY ON SOLID GROUND StillArt (Finland) and its associated companies are established and profitable, with about €2 million in annual turnover, a team of four, and two dozen suppliers in a dozen countries. Unique products and clear plans for international growth mean this role grows as the companies do.THE ROLE As Executive Assistant, you guard the CEO's energy, momentum and focus, so his hours go where they are worth the most: winning clients, solving the problems only the CEO can solve, building the brand and starting what comes next. Everything that pulls him out of that zone, you take, and you take it so well he never has to look back. This is not a role for someone who waits for instructions. It is a partnership. You lead the daily rhythm, you arrive with the agenda, and within three months you are anticipating the next move.WHAT YOU WILL OWN This is a role with real ownership. From your first weeks, these are yours: The inbox. You triage, decide and reply, so only what truly needs the CEO reaches him. The calendar. You manage scheduling across the companies in the group, guard focus time and prepare the week ahead. Follow-through. Loose ends close because you close them, with the team, leads and clients. Momentum. You keep notes, actions and the project list moving, so the best ideas actually get implemented. Travel and events. Conferences, flights and hotels arranged to a high standard. Purchases and payments. Handled correctly, within limits the CEO sets. Voice and visibility. Social posts and copy coordinated with the right people. The daily rhythm. A short morning check-in and an end-of-day hand-off that previews tomorrow's one big thing. Planning together. You plan and prioritize alongside the CEO, with more independence as trust grows, and you serve as a sounding board when it is time to decide which ideas earn traction now.WHY THIS ROLE IS SOUGHT AFTER A seat beside the founder. You work directly with the CEO, close enough to shape the company's next chapter. A role built with you. The scope is designed around the person who takes it, and you carry the responsibility to build it. A 90-day path. A structured training program, in three stages, so you are never left guessing how to be impactful.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Calm in motion. Steady when plans change fast. Proactive by instinct. You see what needs doing before you are asked. Curious and always learning. New tools, new products, new markets, new ways of working, including AI. The CEO has a voracious appetite for learning. Entrepreneurial at heart. At home in a founder-led company where change moves quickly, and energized by growth. Experienced and discerning. You have run a busy executive's day before, as an executive assistant or in a similar supporting role, and senior team members take you seriously. Strong with people. A real listener who makes a room feel safe. You guide as much as you assist. Trusted with what matters. Discreet with sensitive information, trusted with visibility of company and personal money, and comfortable with finance basics. Careful with detail. You would rather get it right than get it fast. To show us, add the word intern to the last field on the application form. Fluent in Microsoft tools. StillArt runs on Microsoft 365, including Planner, OneDrive, Outlook and Copilot. Culture oriented. You care about the arts and about being of service to arts organizations. Experience in the arts is a plus. At home across languages and cultures. English is a must. jobs.title: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasksThe position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Vær med til at gøre frokostpausen lidt bedre – vi søger en køkkenmedhjælper til Haderslev Katedralskole
jobs.description:
Kan du lide at have hænderne i maden, et smil på læben og mange bolde i luften? Trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både laver lækker mad, møder gæsterne ved disken og giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler på holdet hos DinnerdeLuxe på Haderslev Katedralskole.

Vi søger en serviceminded køkkenmedhjælper til et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen. Du har gerne mindst 3 års erfaring med kantinedrift, er vant til at tage fat og ved, hvad der skal til for at få en travl kantinehverdag til at glide.

Det er stillingen krydret med:

  • Et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen med arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 8.00 og 14.30

  • En afvekslende hverdag med både madproduktion, gæsteservice og praktiske opgaver

  • Et moderne kantinekoncept med fokus på god mad og gode råvarer

  • Mulighed for at tage ansvar og være med til at skabe gode frokostoplevelser

God mad, glade gæster og en hverdag med fart på

I kantinen på Haderslev Katedralskole er du med til at give elever og medarbejdere en god pause i hverdagen. Her handler det ikke kun om at få maden på bordet, men også om at skabe en hyggelig og imødekommende oplevelse for dem, der besøger kantinen.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt. Den ene stund er du i gang med at tilberede mad, og den næste står du ved kassen og møder gæsterne med et smil. Du er ikke bange for at tage fat, og du ved, at de små detaljer gør en stor forskel.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tilberede og klargøre velsmagende mad til kantinens gæster

  • Betjene kassen og give gæsterne en god og venlig service

  • Anrette, fylde op og sørge for, at kantinen altid fremstår indbydende

  • Hjælpe med opvask, rengøring og de praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

  • Bidrage til, at den daglige kantinedrift fungerer godt

Du har styr på kantinehverdagen – og smil på læben

Du behøver ikke være uddannet kok eller cater. Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring fra en kantine, kan lide at arbejde med mad og trives med både de praktiske opgaver og kontakten til gæsterne.

Vi ser gerne, at du har mindst 3 års erfaring med kantinedrift og derfor hurtigt kan finde dig til rette i en hverdag, hvor der nogle gange er fart på.

Vi glæder os til en kollega, der:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for sine opgaver

  • Har erfaring med madproduktion og den daglige drift af en kantine

  • Er serviceminded og møder gæsterne med et smil

  • Er fleksibel, har overblik og gerne giver en ekstra hånd

  • Bidrager med godt humør og en positiv indstilling

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Vi vil gerne have dig med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Der er tale om et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat – så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV, meget gerne med referencer, til job.kenneth@dinnerdeluxe.dk, og skriv "Køkkenmedhjælper Haderslev" i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Drifts- og Kundechef Kenneth Kirkedal Thomsen på telefon 25 28 28 88 eller ovenstående mailadresse.

Hvis du oplyser referencer, betragter vi det som samtykke til, at vi må kontakte dem. Af hensyn til GDPR skal du sende din ansøgning til ovenstående mailadresse. Oplys kun de nødvendige personoplysninger, såsom navn, telefonnummer og mailadresse.

Har du sans for detaljen og erfaring med afdækning, slibning og lakering? Er du stolt, når en bil forlader kabinen med en flot, ensartet og spejlblank finish? Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Vamdrup søger vi en autolakerer, som arbejder selvstændigt, holder overblikket og har lyst til at indgå i et godt fællesskab.

Om Byens Bilpleje

Byens Bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og er i dag en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas. Hos Byensbilpleje.com håndterer vi mere end 200.000 biler om året og har mere end 400 medarbejdere.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med

Din arbejdsdag byder på klargøring og lakering af biler. Du spartler, sliber og afdækker, udbedrer mindre buler og ridser og udfører sprøjtelakering. Undervejs sikrer du, at kvaliteten er i orden, og at hver opgave bliver afsluttet ordentligt. Du planlægger dine opgaver i samspil med resten af teamet og hjælper med afdelingens øvrige arbejde efter behov.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Ordne buler, spartle, slibe og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), så bilerne står som nye.
  • Bidrage til at kvaliteten altid er i top.
  • Tage ansvar for egne arbejdsopgaver, og hjælpe resten af teamet, når der er brug for det.
  • Håndtere de øvrige opgaver, der naturligt følger med jobbet som autolakerer.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer.
  • Kan strukturere dine opgaver og tilpasse dig dagens arbejdsflow.
  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for finish.
  • Tager ansvar og hjælper dine kollegaer.
  • Har kørekort til personbil.
  • Du må også gerne have humor og sætte pris på, at der er plads til en god bemærkning i løbet af dagen.

Hos os får du

Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, overenskomst og pension. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk bliver værdsat. Hos os får du adgang til gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter samt mulighed for at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt. Hverdagen byder på dygtige kollegaer, godt humør og en uformel omgangstone.

Så send din ansøgning via www.byensbilpleje.com. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, og ansætter når vi har fundet den rigtige kollega - dog venter vi selvfølgelig gerne på det rette match.

jobs.title: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
  • Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
  • Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
  • Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions)
  • Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.
You have:
  • A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems
  • Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects
  • Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.
MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
  • A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: MHPSS Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: Aktiviteettipäällikkö Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhaan
jobs.description: Tykkäätkö keksiä uutta, innostaa ihmisiä ja saada asioita tapahtumaan? Haluaisitko olla mukana luomassa elämyksiä, jotka tekevät asiakkaidemme lomasta ja vapaa-ajasta entistäkin ikimuistoisemman?Etsimme nyt joukkoomme idearikasta, innostavaa ja toimeen tarttuvaa aktiviteettipäällikköä vastaamaan Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettien suunnittelusta, kehittämisestä ja toteutuksesta. Tehtävässä johdat omaa tiimiäsi, kehität palvelutarjontaa sekä vastaat aktiviteettien vetovoimasta ja kannattavuudesta. Osallistut myös käytännön tekemiseen arjen toiminnassa. Tarjoamme vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen tehtävän.TehtävästäAktiviteettipäällikkönä vastaat Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettikokonaisuudesta sekä aktiviteettitiimin esihenkilötyöstä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Resort Managerin kanssa ja raportoit tehtävässäsi hänelle. Kehität toimintaa asiakaslähtöisesti ja huolehdit samalla siitä, että aktiviteettitarjonta tukee myös resortin liiketoimintaa.Tehtävä on lähityötä Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhassa, sillä aktiviteettien kehittäminen, toteuttaminen ja tiimin johtaminen edellyttävät vahvaa läsnäoloa paikan päällä.KohteestaHoliday Club Saimaan Rauha on Saimaan rannalla sijaitseva monipuolinen lomakeskus, jossa yhdistyvät majoitus, ravintolat, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut sekä laaja aktiviteettitarjonta. Sesonki- ja tapahtumatoiminta tekee arjesta vaihtelevaa ja elämyksellistä ympäri vuoden.Mitä odotamme sinulta?- sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. liikunnanohjaaja AMK); arvostamme myös liikunta- ja hyvinvointialan lisäkoulutuksia, kuten personal trainerin pätevyyttä- kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä kykyä johtaa ja innostaa tiimiä- kokemusta liikunta-, hyvinvointi- tai muiden aktiviteettien suunnittelusta ja ohjaamisesta- luovaa ja kehittävää työotetta sekä rohkeutta kokeilla uutta- positiivista asennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisiin- asiakaslähtöistä ajattelua, organisointikykyä ja ymmärrystä kannattavasta liiketoiminnastaJa näitä voimme tarjota sinulle:- monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää suuren resortin aktiviteettikokonaisuutta- kattavan perehdytyksen- osaavan tiimin, jolta saat täyden tuen- Holiday Clubin laajat henkilöstöedut vapaa-ajalla muun muassa hotelleista, loma-asunnoista, kylpylöistä ja ravintoloista ympäri SuomenNäin haetKiinnostuitko? Jos emme onnistuneet vastaamaan kaikkiin kysymyksiisi tässä ilmoituksessa, Resort Manager Minna Nyman (0444580339) vastaa mielellään tehtävää koskeviin kysymyksiin torstaina 29.10. klo 10-11 ja tiistaina 3.11. klo 13-14.Holiday Club ResortsHoliday Club Resorts on yksi johtavista matkailun ja vapaa-ajan asumisen toimijoista Suomessa.
