jobs.title: Accounting and Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything.  Aprio has 40 U.S. office locations, as well as international office locations and more than 3,200 team members that speak 60+ languages across the globe.  By bringing together proven expertise, deep understanding, and strategic foresight for fast-growing industries, Aprio ensures clients are prepared for wherever life or business may take them. Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio.


Aprio is seeking an Aprio is seeking an Accounting and Implementation Manager  to lead restaurant, franchise, and hospitality platform implementations, re-implementations, and optimization initiatives that connect accounting, operations, and technology. In this role, you will partner with clients and our accounting team to translate complex accounting and operational needs into practical configurations, integrations, workflows, controls, reporting structures, and training across platforms including Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools. You will serve as a trusted technology resource across the practice â driving implementation quality, enabling team capability, and building a repeatable, scalable delivery model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a systems-minded professional who brings both accounting fluency and a practical approach to helping people get the most from their technology.

\n


What You'll Gain/ Impact
  • Clients will have platform environments that support reliable accounting, disciplined operations, strong controls, and sustainable growth
  • Our accounting team will have the tools, training, documentation, and responsive support needed to serve clients efficiently across multiple platforms
  • Implementations will move forward with clear ownership, clean master data, disciplined testing, timely decisions, and fewer surprises
  • Your improvements will reduce manual work, strengthen operating data, and build a repeatable, high-value delivery capability across the practice
 


Key Responsibilities

Platform Implementation & Re-Implementation

  • Lead implementations and re-implementations across restaurant, franchise, and hospitality platforms â including R365, QBO, Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools â from discovery and design through configuration, testing, cutover, and stabilization
  • Partner with clients and our accounting team to translate accounting and operational needs into practical plans, system designs, and success criteria
  • Configure and validate entities, locations, calendars, chart of accounts, reporting, user roles, approvals, banking, daily sales, AP, payroll, and inventory workflows
  • Guide data readiness, testing, decisions, and go-live activities while helping the accounting team resolve issues that affect service delivery, close, and reporting

Client Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Own accounting and financial reporting for assigned clients, including agreed-upon deliverables, deadlines, responsibilities, and scope.
  • Lead month-end and year-end close, using technology and automation where appropriate to improve consistency, identify exceptions, and accelerate routine work.
  • Prepare and review complete, accurate, and well-supported workpapers that clearly document account activity, reconciliations, conclusions, and the audit trail supporting financial reporting.

Restaurant Operations Configuration

  • Build and govern inventory items, categories, locations, count practices, costing methods, and location availability
  • Review and map vendor items; configure units of measure, pack sizes, conversions, and yields to support accurate purchasing, invoicing, and inventory valuation
  • Build recipes, sub-recipes, menu items, and theoretical costs; map POS and PMIX data to recipes and resolve exceptions affecting usage and margin reporting
  • Configure labor scheduling, job codes, forecasting inputs, and targets; establish best-practice routines for counts, waste, transfers, receiving, recipe maintenance, and exception review

Platform Optimization & Process Design

  • Evaluate platform environments â including R365, QBO, Sage Intacct, and other tools â alongside accounting and operations teams to identify configuration gaps, workarounds, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities
  • Simplify and standardize workflows, templates, naming conventions, approvals, dashboards, and recurring processes across entities and locations
  • Prioritize improvements based on impact, effort, risk, and readiness, then help teams adopt sustainable platform governance

Integrations, Data & Reporting

  • Coordinate POS, banking, invoice capture, payments, payroll, sales, inventory, and other integrations across applicable platforms
  • Lead mapping, migration, validation, exception resolution, and testing so the accounting team can rely on complete, accurate data
  • Build reporting structures, dashboards, and role-based access that help accounting teams deliver timely, decision-ready information to clients

Training, Adoption & Knowledge Enablement

  • Develop and deliver role-based training for our accounting team, client administrators, and accounting, AP, banking, sales, inventory, purchasing, recipe, labor, payroll, and close users across applicable platforms
  • Coach users on best practices for counts, item and unit-of-measure governance, recipes, POS/PMIX exceptions, labor scheduling, and data-quality reviews
  • Create clear documentation, job aids, workflows, controls, governance standards, and troubleshooting guidance the accounting team can use in daily client service
  • Provide post-go-live support, address recurring pain points, and recommend targeted training or system improvements
 


Candidate Qualifications

Required:

  • Experience supporting restaurant, franchise, hospitality, multi-entity, or multi-location businesses
  • Background in outsourced accounting, CAS, public accounting, or another multi-client professional-services environment
  • Experience improving accounting, reporting, analytics, or client-service workflows through technology or automation 
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, Hospitality Management, Project Management, or a related field
  • Five or more years of ERP implementation, accounting technology, restaurant systems or operations, systems consulting, or related professional-services experience
  • Hands-on experience with Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, or comparable restaurant, franchise, or hospitality platform implementation, administration, optimization, or support
  • Working knowledge of close, reporting, banking, daily sales, AP, inventory, purchasing, item mapping, units of measure, recipes, POS/PMIX, payroll, labor scheduling, and controls
  • Strong client-facing project leadership, facilitation, documentation, problem-solving, change-management, and communication skills

Preferred:

  • R365 certification, Sage Intacct certification, or advanced experience across accounting and operations modules
  • Restaurant, franchise, hospitality, multi-entity, or multi-location experience, including POS/PMIX, inventory, recipe costing, labor, AP, payroll, banking, and reporting tools
  • Experience across multiple restaurant, franchise, or hospitality platforms such as QBO, Sage Intacct, or other industry-specific ERP and accounting solutions
  • Experience in outsourced accounting, CAS, ERP consulting, restaurant technology, culinary systems, or scalable implementation and governance design
 


\n

Why work for Aprio:

Whether you are just starting out, looking to advance into management or searching for your next leadership role, Aprio offers an opportunity to grow with a future-focused, innovative firm.

- 401k with Profit Sharing

- 9+ holidays and discretionary time off structure

- Parental Leave â coverage for both primary and secondary caregivers

- Tuition Assistance Program and CPA support program with cash incentive upon completion

- Discretionary incentive compensation based on firm, group and individual performance

- Incentive compensation related to origination of new client sales

Whatâs in it for you:

jobs.title: Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Switching Leader
jobs.description:
Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Electrical Operations / Switching Leader

Location: DenmarkEmployment type: Full-timeEmployer: Global Nordics

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Authorised Person (SAP) / Switching Leader (Koblingsleder) to support electrical operations on a major engineering project in Denmark.

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating safe switching operations, electrical isolations and safety procedures across high-voltage (HV) and low-voltage (LV) electrical systems.

The position operates within an established electrical safety management structure, under the designated Operation Manager (Driftsansvarlig Person), and in accordance with applicable Danish electrical safety regulations and EN 50110-1.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee HV and LV switching operations.

  • Prepare and review switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Coordinate electrical isolations, earthing and safe access procedures.

  • Prepare, issue and cancel safety documents within the scope of assigned authorisation.

  • Coordinate with Control Engineers and electrical work teams during operational activities.

  • Ensure appropriate safety precautions are implemented before electrical work begins.

  • Supervise and coordinate personnel involved in electrical operational activities.

  • Support commissioning, energisation and electrical system handover.

  • Maintain accurate switching records, operational logs and safety documentation.

  • Participate in safety audits, risk assessments and toolbox talks.

  • Ensure compliance with site-specific electrical safety procedures and applicable Danish regulations.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualification in electrical engineering or equivalent professional experience.

  • Extensive experience working with HV and LV electrical systems.

  • Previous experience as a Senior Authorised Person, Switching Leader, Control Engineer or equivalent.

  • Strong understanding of electrical switching, isolation, earthing and safe working procedures.

  • Knowledge of EN 50110-1 and electrical safety management systems.

  • Experience preparing switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate electrical work teams and operational activities.

  • Strong communication, organisational and safety leadership skills.

  • Good command of English.

Electrical Safety Requirements

The successful candidate will undergo a competence assessment and receive the necessary written operational appointment and authorisation under the project's Danish electrical safety management arrangements (KLS-D) before undertaking regulated electrical activities.

The role does not include statutory Operation Manager responsibilities or electrical installation work requiring separate company authorisation.

Application

Please submit your CV, relevant qualifications and details of your professional experience.

 - Experience in public accounting or audit, or in corporate accounting; candidates early in their careers, including new graduates with relevant experience, are welcome.

 - Curiosity to learn country-specific requirements as Notion expands.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Brand
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for an experienced, creative, and rigorous brand campaign expert who excels at conceptualizing innovative campaign strategies and bringing clarity to complex challenges.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Manager, Brand brings Notion’s mission, product capabilities, and customer stories to life through targeted, insight-driven brand campaigns. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and executing integrated marketing programs that connect Notion’s core value props to the needs and aspirations of our customers—from individuals to global enterprises.

Reporting to the Campaign Lead, you’ll drive seasonal campaigns, brand activations, and special projects that aim to build excitement among both current customers and prospects. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative to transform feature launches, product education, and customer insights into powerful, scalable brand moments that build understanding, drive conversion, and reinforce Notion’s position as the AI workspace for teams. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead cross-functional campaign execution, from concept to delivery, for both special brand projects and feature-led programs

 - Partner with Creative to generate out-of-the-box brand marketing concepts, breaking from the industry mold and encouraging blue sky thinking

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop strategies that translate product value into meaningful narratives for the target audience of each activation or campaign

 - Partner with Growth Marketing to define the right mix of content, media, and channels to reach each segment effectively

 - Manage campaign briefs, creative deliverables, and timelines—ensuring clarity, accountability, and alignment across stakeholders

 - Integrate brand and performance media buying from planning through delivery and reporting

 - Define and track KPIs for each campaign, analyzing and sharing results and applying insights to optimize future programs

 - Ensure all campaigns maintain a cohesive Notion voice and brand expression, while adapting to audience needs and regional contexts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with proven success leading complex projects to fruition

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with new AI tools, and are passionate about staying on top of fast-moving industry trends

 - Speed: You bias towards action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - GTM expert: You have strong understanding of and passion for go-to-market planning, messaging, and storytelling for brand-driven campaigns

 - Collaborative: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you, across product, creative, and data teams

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to balance multiple work streams and deadlines at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting

 - Experience supporting global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 – $195,000 per year.

AI Trainer - Video Annotation

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 


▌ What you will do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.


Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
jobs.description:
About the positionThe Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC).The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions.The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.Key responsibilitiesStrategic leadership and governance

  • Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates.

  • Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability.

  • Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.

Management, organisation and budget

  • Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state.

  • Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices.

  • Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.

Operational responsibility

  • Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication.

  • Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.

About youTo succeed in this role, we expect that you:

  • Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage.

  • Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level.

  • Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions.

  • Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally.

  • Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.

In addition, you:

  • Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations.

  • Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries.

  • Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.

About the Danish Resilience AgencyThe Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure.We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment.About the NBCCThe NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity.The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats.Salary and terms of employmentSalary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness.Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment.The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension.The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen.To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk SamarbejdeIf the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee.Are you interested?Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th November 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education.For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257.All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background.Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy, with background in one or more of the following areas: philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, phenomenology.We are looking for a person with a relevant degree (M.A., MSc. etc.) in philosophy or a related field. Starting date is September 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fully funded, full-time, for three years. The PhD degree will be awarded by the Faculty of Health Sciences.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will be based in the research group of Applied and Interdisciplinary Phenomenology in the Department of Psychology, SDU, at the Odense campus. The research group develops, disseminates, and applies methods to support cutting-edge research into subjectivity and the nature of human experience. Current group members have backgrounds in philosophy, psychology, anthropology, neuroscience, environmental studies, and pain research.

The group directly supports the professional development of its members, most of whom are postdocs or PhD students. In addition to receiving support from the project team, the PhD student will be supported by the broader group to develop their research, presentation, and teaching skills, as well as other academic skills, including those required for organizing academic activities such as workshops and conferences and for successful grant-writing. The PhD student will therefore be provided with the requisite knowledge and skills for pursuing an academic career in Europe or abroad.

The PhD student will also be provided with a work computer and a dedicated workspace at the Department of Psychology.

 

Project description

The PhD student will be part of the project, Understanding Experiences of Mood Disturbances in Depression (DEPMOOD), led by Anthony Vincent Fernandez. The project is funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark and runs for four years, starting September 1st, 2026. The PhD student will join the project for the final three years, collaborating with the PI, a psychology postdoc, and several external partners in Europe and the US, including philosophers, clinical psychologists, and psychiatrists.

The aim of the project is to establish a taxonomy of the variety of mood disturbances experienced by people diagnosed with depression, providing more precise characterizations of symptoms than those currently offered by concepts such as “depressed mood” or “anhedonia”. The project combines philosophical and qualitative methods, and includes in-depth interviews with people diagnosed with depression. The PhD student will not be expected to carry out interviews, as these will be conducted by the postdoc and external project partners. The PhD student’s primary role will be to help analyze the interview data using a combination of qualitative and philosophical methods. Their PhD thesis will therefore be a theoretical contribution, but will build upon the project’s empirical dataset.

In addition to producing a thesis, the PhD student will be required to take a variety of short PhD courses, carry out an international research stay, and fulfil light teaching duties.

The PhD student will be provided with DKK 10,000 per year for travel. Additional funds may be available.

 

Qualifications

Before the start date of September 1st, 2027, the applicant should have a master’s degree in philosophy or a related field and total course credits equivalent to 300 ECTS. Typically, this is a total of at least five years of education combined between bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with 60 ECTS obtained for every full year of study.

The candidate should have a background in philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, and/or phenomenology. Familiarity with qualitative research methods (especially analysis methods) is an advantage, but by no means required.

The candidate should be proficient in English. Proficiency in Danish or another Scandinavian language may be an advantage, but is not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:Anthony Vincent Fernandez

Department of Psychology

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: afernandez@health.sdu.dk

Please note that while we are happy to provide answers to questions about the position and application process, direct feedback on application materials cannot be provided.

Applications must include (in English, or with a certified English translation):

 

  1. A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.

  2. Detailed CV, including personal contact information as well as any publications or presentations

  3. Certified copy of diploma and transcripts (Master’s degree in a relevant field). If the applicant is in the process of completing their master’s degree, they should provide transcripts along with a letter from their supervisor confirming expected completion of their degree before September 1st, 2027.

  4. Writing sample of maximum 10,000 words (e.g., publication, conference paper, selection from a master’s thesis). If the sample exceeds this length, please indicate which section should be read.

  5. A document listing 2-3 references, with contact information and a brief note about your relation to the reference. Note that reference letters will only be requested for candidates invited to interview. 

At this stage, no project proposal is required. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to prepare a brief project plan.

Please do not use generative AI in the formulation of any application materials. The purpose of these materials is to gain a clear sense of you and your abilities.

Shortlisting and interviews may be used in the assessment process. 

For purposes of evaluation and assessment, application materials may be shared with external members of the project team at Aarhus University and Amsterdam University Medical Center.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated

 

Closing date January 15th, 2027 

We expect to conduct interviews within two months of the application closing date.Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students. 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98   per year.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Position : Senior Finance Manager / Management AccountantÂ 

Salary : PHP 90,000 - PHP 110,000 /month

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Our client is an end-to-end B2B SaaS platform delivering specialized workforce management software designed for operational precision across scheduling, compliance, time tracking, invoicing, and payroll. Operating in a high-volume, multi-entity environment undergoing rapid international expansion and strategic acquisitions, the organization is bringing its core finance operations fully in-house to support scalable long-term growth. Working closely with executive leadership, this critical role goes beyond traditional accounting to take complete ownership of financial consolidations, month-end close optimization, SaaS performance metrics, and commercial analysis. We are seeking a proactive leader with a Financial Controller mindset who can independently challenge assumptions, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and bring clear financial visibility to strategic executive decisions.Â 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Financial Close, Reporting & Multi-Entity Consolidation:
    • Take end-to-end ownership of the month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and consolidated financial reporting.
    • Lead the strategic transition of financial close and reporting activities from external advisers to the internal finance function.
    • Audit and streamline close workflows to significantly reduce month-end closing timelines from 2â3 weeks.
    • Prepare accurate, consolidated profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports across multiple domestic and international entities while maintaining audit-ready documentation.
  • Management Accounting & Commercial Analysis:
    • Deliver monthly management accounts supported by deep, commercially relevant commentary on business performance and profitability drivers.
    • Perform budget-versus-actual and month-on-month variance analyses, actively investigating root causes rather than merely reporting numbers.
    • Develop, maintain, and refine annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and multi-entity cash flow projections.
    • Partner with executive leadership to evaluate operational margins, identify financial risks, and translate complex financial data into actionable growth strategies.
  • SaaS Performance Metrics & Revenue Recognition:
    • Track, analyze, and report on key SaaS metrics, including MRR, ARR, churn, customer retention, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and customer lifetime value (LTV).
    • Reconcile complex subscription, recurring billing, and usage data with core management accounts in full alignment with revenue recognition principles.
  • Acquisitions & Process Transformation:
    • Support post-acquisition financial integrations, harmonizing accounting policies, chart of accounts, and financial frameworks across acquired businesses.
    • Audit existing financial workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and implement modern automation tools and robust internal controls.
    • Coach and uplift existing bookkeeping and operational finance team members, establishing clear procedures, responsibilities, and reporting deadlines.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience: Minimum 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including substantial senior management accounting, finance manager, or financial controller responsibilities.
  • Industry Background: Proven experience operating within a B2B SaaS, subscription-based technology, or recurring revenue software business.
  • Core Technical Competencies: Demonstrated ownership of financial consolidations, multi-entity accounting, month-end close streamlining, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • SaaS Expertise: Deep working knowledge of subscription billing models, revenue recognition standards, and core SaaS unit economics (MRR/ARR/Churn).
  • Education & Skills: Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; advanced Excel skills for complex financial modeling; and exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for senior stakeholder management.

DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED):

  • Professional qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent.

  • Exposure to Australian accounting standards, tax compliance, and business frameworks.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life's work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down
   
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication
   
    


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

jobs.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â 

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

  • High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients
  • Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better
  • Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential
  • High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected
  • Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â  politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â 

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â 

This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â 

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations ManagementÂ 

  • Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly.
  • Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â 
  • Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â 
  • Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â 
  • Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â 
  • Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ 

  • Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time.
  • Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â 
  • Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â 
  • Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â 
  • Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â 
  • Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â 
  • Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â 

Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ 

  • Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â 
  • Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â 
  • Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â 
  • Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â 
  • Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â 
  • Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â 
  • Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â 
  • Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â 
  • Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances.
  • Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â 

Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ 

  • Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â 
  • Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â 
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â 
  • Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â 
  • Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â 

Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ 

  • Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â 
  • Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â 
  • Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â 
  • Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â 
  • Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â 
  • Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â 

Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ 

  • Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â 
  • Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â 
  • Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â 
  • Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â 
  • Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â 
  • Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â 
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows.
  • Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows.
  • Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â 
  • Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â 

Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ 

  • Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â 
  • Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â 
  • Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â 
  • Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â 
  • Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â 
  • Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â 
Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required QualificationsÂ 

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â 
  • Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â 
  • Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â 
  • Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools.
  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required.
  • Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â 
  • Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â 
  • High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment.

Â Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 
  • 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â 
  • Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred.
  • Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â 
  • Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â 
  • Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â 
  • Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â 
  • Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â 
  • Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â 
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â 
What We Offer

This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Weâre dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

  • Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus

  • Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.

  • Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.

  • Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, APAC
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates residing in Australia or Singapore only. You can work from anywhere within those countries. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through a variety of communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

 - Deliver high-touch Enterprise support at scale, navigating complex account needs alongside Customer Success and Sales

Requirements

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Currently based in Australia or Singapore.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Role Overview

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with San Francisco or New York preferred. You can work from anywhere within the US. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

jobs.title: Growth Engineer, Startups & SMBs
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a hands-on Growth engineer to help grow Notion’s Startups and SMB programs. You’ll work closely with our Ecosystem Growth Lead to help more businesses grow with Notion.

You can spot opportunities in the data and own the executing on the plan that follows. You’re comfortable getting into the tools yourself, moving quickly without sacrificing accuracy, and staying accountable for results.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Work with a small team that operates like a growth lab. Startups and SMBs are the proving ground for ideas that can change how Notion grows.

 - Build and launch new growth programs, from creator-led acquisition to AI-powered systems for testing new audiences and campaigns. Bring your own ideas and take responsibility for getting them off the ground.

 - Move quickly from a rough hypothesis to a live experiment. Write code for new in-product experiences and build alongside Storytelling, Product, and Engineering to get your work into customers’ hands.

 - Use SQL and customer research to find overlooked opportunities. Measure what changes customer behavior and revenue, and use the results to choose where to go next.

 - Turn the strongest experiments into programs other teams can run. Build the systems and playbooks for them to expand across Notion, then take on the next growth challenge.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years and a record of shipping growth or operations projects. You can explain what you personally built and what changed as a result.

 - Typescript, Full-stack, and Systems-thinking

 - Strong SQL and analytical judgment. You can work through messy data and distinguish a promising signal from a misleading result.

 - Hands-on experience building campaigns or automated workflows in tools such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Salesforce, or comparable platforms.

 - The ability to take an ambiguous goal and execute on growth initiatives. You unblock yourself where possible and communicate clearly when you need another team’s help.

 - Experience with self-serve SaaS or startup and SMB customers is a plus. If you’ve done similar work but with a different title, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

   - Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.

   - Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.
